title: Corporate Legal Counsel/Attorney
description:
The Company You’ll Join



OCD Anxiety Centers is passionate about bringing help and hope to individuals and families affected by anxiety and related disorders. We are an evidence-based behavioral health organization committed to using effective, research-supported treatments and staying current with the latest developments in clinical care.



We believe in doing meaningful work, supporting our clients, and maintaining high standards of integrity, accountability, teamwork, and excellence.



The Team You’ll Work With



Our success depends on the trust and confidence we build with our employees, clients, and community. We value:



* Integrity and honest, open communication

* Accountability for our actions and responsibilities

* Teamwork and collaboration

* Excellence and continuous improvement

* Respect for others and diversity

* Passion for serving our clients and supporting company goals



Position Purpose



The Corporate In-House Attorney provides legal guidance and support to a fast-growing behavioral health organization. This role will help the company manage contracts, regulatory and compliance matters, employment issues, risk, disputes, policies, and other legal needs.



Key Performance Indicators



Success in this role will be measured by the ability to:



* Draft, review, negotiate, and coordinate contracts within agreed timelines.

* Keep legal matter trackers, contract files, templates, and legal records organized and up to date.

* Provide timely legal guidance to company leaders and departments.

* Help reduce unnecessary outside legal expenses by handling appropriate matters internally.

* Coordinate effectively with outside counsel when specialized legal support is needed.

* Support compliance, policy development, training, and audit readiness.

* Identify and escalate high-risk legal matters before they become larger problems.

* Provide clear recommendations, options, and next steps when legal risks arise.

* Maintain accurate documentation and communication related to legal matters.



Core Competencies



The successful candidate should demonstrate:



* Strong knowledge of corporate and business law.

* Good legal judgment and problem-solving skills.

* Strong organization and attention to detail.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

* Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information professionally.

* Ability to work independently in a fast-moving organization.

* Strong follow-through and accountability.

* Ability to manage multiple legal matters and competing priorities.

* Ability to identify risks and communicate them clearly.

* Professional and collaborative approach when working with leadership and other departments.



Core Responsibilities



Contract and Legal Support



* Draft, review, and negotiate contracts, leases, vendor agreements, payor agreements, and employment-related documents.

* Review contract terms and identify potential legal and business risks.

* Advise leaders on contract obligations, deadlines, confidentiality, termination rights, and risk allocation.

* Maintain legal templates, approved contract language, and contract playbooks.

* Help establish and maintain consistent legal review and approval processes.



Legal, Compliance, and Risk Management



* Provide legal guidance on corporate, employment, healthcare, regulatory, privacy, and operational matters.

* Support compliance initiatives, internal policies, training, and legal readiness.

* Assist with dispute resolution and responses to legal concerns.

* Identify potential legal and compliance risks and recommend appropriate actions.

* Support audits, due diligence, and other legal or regulatory reviews.



Outside Counsel and Legal Matters



* Coordinate with outside counsel on litigation, state-specific legal matters, specialized advice, and major transactions.

* Track outside counsel matters, budgets, and legal expenses.

* Maintain organized legal matter logs and records.

* Provide leadership with clear updates on important legal matters and risks.



Systems, Documentation, and Reporting



* Maintain organized legal files, trackers, contracts, SOPs, and reports.

* Keep documentation accurate, current, and easy to review.

* Maintain clear records of legal decisions, communications, and follow-up actions.

* Provide regular status updates to leadership as needed.



Cross-Functional Collaboration



* Work closely with leadership and other departments to understand business needs and provide practical legal solutions.

* Ensure legal handoffs and responsibilities are clearly documented.

* Communicate clearly with internal teams, outside counsel, and other stakeholders.

* Escalate unclear ownership, missing information, compliance concerns, or significant risks promptly.



Required Qualifications



* 5+ years of legal experience preferred.

* Experience in one or more of the following areas is preferred:



  * Corporate law

  * Healthcare law

  * Employment law

  * Contract law

  * Regulatory or compliance matters

  * Business operations



Skills and Expertise



* Contract drafting and negotiation

* Legal research and analysis

* Risk assessment and management

* Corporate and employment law

* Healthcare compliance and regulatory matters

* Policy and procedure development

* Dispute resolution and legal support

* Outside counsel coordination

* Strong written and verbal communication

* Executive-level communication and judgment

* Excellent organization and attention to detail



Performance Growth



Once the key performance indicators are consistently achieved, the supervisor will meet with the employee to review progress and establish new performance goals that support continued growth, development, and excellence.

title: DATA ENTRY VA
description:
RELIABLE DATA ENTRY VA WANTED



We need ONE detail-obsessed Virtual Assistant for our D2C E-commerce brand.



- THE OPPORTUNITY:



Position: Data Entry VA (Spreadsheet / Reporting Support)

Commitment: Long-term partnership (not one-off freelance)

Compensation: $70/month for ~30 min/day, with a clear path to more hours and higher pay

Location: 100% Remote & Flexible

Hours: 30 minutes per day, 7 days/week (do it whenever fits your schedule)



Your Growth Path:



Month 1-2: Daily data entry (30 min/day) → $70/month

Next step: Expanded VA responsibilities with significantly more hours, and pay that scales with them

Long-term: Core team member with real ownership over a function



We'd rather promote someone who already knows our business than hire a stranger.



- THE MISSION:



Clean data is the foundation of every decision we make. Every number you enter feeds directly into how we spend, what we launch, and how fast we grow. Small task, real impact.



- WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR (BE HONEST, WE'LL VERIFY)



MUST-HAVE:



Basic Excel / Google Sheets proficiency (copy, paste, filter, format)

Absolute consistency: you show up 7 days a week, every week

Stable internet and a computer (not phone-only)

Attention to detail, you double-check before you submit



STRONG PREFERENCE:



Previous VA, admin, or back-office experience

Familiarity with Shopify/Funnelish or e-commerce dashboards

Ability to learn new tools and processes quickly

Availability to expand hours within 2-3 months



- WHAT SETS YOU APART:



You treat a 30-minute task with the same seriousness as an 8-hour one

You never leave a field blank or guess a number, you ask

You communicate proactively when something looks wrong in the data

You want to grow inside one company instead of juggling ten clients



ATTENTION:



We receive 50+ applications per post. Only 2-3 get interviews.



What makes the difference?



Proof you can be trusted with recurring, unsupervised work

Clear, professional communication in your first message

Genuine interest in growing with us long-term (not just filling a gap)



Warning: We move fast. The best candidates often get hired within a week of applying.



Please fill out this form to submit your application; messages sent via chat will not be read:

title: GRAPHIC DESIGNER — LONG-TERM PARTNERSHIP
description:
Let me be upfront with you, because that's how we operate.



We're a D2C e-commerce brand in the women's health space. We run paid ads on Meta. We sell a product that genuinely helps people, and every visual we produce reflects that.



Transparency and honesty aren't buzzwords here, they're the reason our customers trust us, and the reason we're still growing.



We've worked with designers before. Some were talented. Most were treated like vendors, asset in, asset out, goodbye.

That's not what we're building.



We're in this for the long game. We want you to be too.



- THE ROLE



Position: Direct Response Graphic Designer for Meta Ads

Commitment: Full-time, long-term (this is not a freelance gig)

Hours: 40h/week

Location: 100% remote

Market: English-speaking (US primary)

Compensation: $600–$800/month base + performance bonuses



- WHAT LONG-TERM ACTUALLY MEANS HERE



Year-over-year salary increases of 10–20% for strong performers.

Performance bonuses tied directly to ad performance and ROAS.

Creative ownership: you'll understand the strategy, the avatar, the psychology behind every visual.

A real team: you'll work closely with the founder and marketing lead, not disappear into a ticket queue.



- WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Non-negotiable:



3+ years as a graphic designer in DTC e-commerce or digital marketing

Proven experience creating ad creatives, landing page visuals, and social content that actually ran

Strong command of Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects)

Experience with AI image generation tools (MidJourney, Leonardo, DALL·E, etc.)

Understanding of conversion-focused design, you know why visual hierarchy matters for an ad



Strong preference:



Health or wellness brand experience

Knowledge of direct-response marketing and what makes someone stop scrolling

Motion graphics or light video editing capability



- WHO THRIVES HERE:



You look at a high-performing ad and instinctively break down why it works.

You care about what happens after the asset goes live, not just whether the client approved it.

You understand that empathy, trust, and clarity aren't soft concepts in health marketing, they're conversion levers.

You want to help build a brand's visual identity over years, not just deliver a batch of assets.



- WHO THIS IS NOT FOR



If you're managing 8 clients simultaneously and fitting us in between, this isn't the right fit.

We want someone who is genuinely invested in one brand's growth, because that's where the real upside is.



- THE PROCESS



We review every application carefully. Portfolio quality matters far more than volume. If your work shows real DTC and direct-response experience, you'll hear from us fast.



We move quickly, but we don't rush decisions on people.



IMPORTANT: We don't check the chat. To apply, please fill out this form: 



Thank you!

title: Accounting Manager / Controller
description:
About the Company:



Kids United is a growing franchisor supporting a network of franchise locations across the United Stated and Canada. We are looking for an experienced accounting professional to take ownership of our accounting function and help build scalable financial processes as the company continues to grow. 



This is a hands-on role that is well suited for an Accounting Manager, Assistant Controller, or Controller-level professional who enjoys being involved in both the day-to-day accounting and the bigger-picture financial operations of a growing organization.



Position Overview



The Accounting Manager / Controller will be responsible for managing the company's accounting operations, maintaining accurate financial records, overseeing the month-end close, preparing financial reporting, and supporting management with financial analysis and decision-making.



The ideal candidate has experience with QuickBooks, strong technical accounting skills, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to work independently in a growing entrepreneurial environment.



Experience with franchising, royalty accounting, multi-location businesses, or recurring revenue models is helpful but not required.



Key Responsibilities:



Accounting & Financial Operations



* Perform the day-to-day accounting functions, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, general ledger, cash management, and reconciliations.

* Maintain accurate and timely financial records in QuickBooks.

* Utilize ADP to run payrolls

* Manage the monthly, quarterly, and annual close processes.

* Prepare and review journal entries, account reconciliations, accruals, and adjusting entries.

* Maintain the chart of accounts and ensure accounting practices are consistent and appropriate as the company grows.

* Monitor cash flow and assist with cash forecasting.

* Coordinate with outside CPA firms and other financial professionals as needed.



Franchise Accounting



* Maintain accurate accounting for franchise-related revenue streams, including royalties, fees, advertising contributions, and other franchise income.

* Reconcile franchisee payments and accounts.

* Monitor outstanding franchisee balances and assist with collections.

* Work with operations and franchise support teams to resolve billing and accounting discrepancies.

* Develop and maintain reliable reporting around franchise revenue and franchisee activity.

* Help establish scalable accounting processes as the franchise network expands.



Financial Reporting & Analysis



* Prepare monthly financial statements, including the income statement, balance sheet, and cash flow reporting.

* Provide management with timely and meaningful financial reports and analysis.

* Analyze financial results, identify trends, and explain significant variances.

* Assist with budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning.

* Develop and improve management reporting and key financial metrics.

* Support ownership and leadership with ad hoc financial analysis and decision-making.



Controls & Process Improvement



* Establish and maintain appropriate accounting controls and procedures.

* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, accuracy, and automation within the accounting function.

* Document accounting processes and develop procedures that can scale with the business.



Qualifications



* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field preferred.

* 5+ years of progressive accounting experience**, with increasing responsibility.

* Experience working in an Accounting Manager, Assistant Controller, Controller, or similar role.

* Strong working knowledge of QuickBooks.

* Strong understanding of GAAP and general accounting principles.

* Experience managing or owning the month-end close process.

* Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills.

* Excellent analytical, organizational, and problem-solving abilities.

* High level of attention to detail and accuracy.

* Ability to work independently and take ownership of the accounting function.

* Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively with both financial and non-financial team members.



Preferred Experience



* Franchisor or franchisee accounting experience.

* Multi-unit or multi-location business experience.

* Experience with royalty, franchise fee, or recurring revenue accounting.

* Experience working with external CPA firms.

* Experience implementing or improving accounting processes and controls.

* CPA or CPA-track experience is a plus but not required.



What We're Looking For



We're looking for someone who is more than a bookkeeper and more than a report preparer. The right person will own the numbers, understand what is driving the business financially, and be comfortable moving between detailed accounting work and higher-level financial analysis.



You should be comfortable working in a growing company where processes may need to be built, improved, and documented rather than simply followed.



This position offers an opportunity for the right candidate to grow into a broader Controller or senior finance leadership role as the company expands.

title: Website & Social Media Specialist for a U.S. Bookkeeping Firm
description:
Website & Social Media Specialist for a U.S. Bookkeeping Firm



We are a growing bookkeeping and financial services firm. We are looking for a reliable, creative, and professional virtual assistant based in the Philippines to establish and maintain our online presence.



This is an ongoing part-time position for someone who can help us look established, trustworthy, and professional online—without making our marketing feel overly trendy, loud, or sales-oriented.



Initial Website Project



Our first priority is creating a simple, polished “business card” website using a Squarespace template.



The website will initially include:



* Home page

* About page

* Services page

* Industries or clients we serve

* Contact page with an inquiry form

* Professional calls to action

* Mobile-friendly formatting

* Basic local SEO setup

* Google Search Console and Google Analytics setup

* Connection to our business
 and social media accounts



The website will provide information and collect inquiries only. We do not need online sales, customer accounts, or complicated website functions.



After the website launches, we want continued work to improve its visibility in search engines—especially for bookkeeping, QuickBooks, cleanup, monthly bookkeeping, and small-business financial services in Southwest Virginia and surrounding areas.



Social Media Responsibilities



We also want to establish a simple, conservative, professional presence on Instagram and possibly
.



Ongoing responsibilities may include:



* Creating and scheduling approximately 2–3 posts each week

* Producing approximately one Reel each week

* Turning our ideas, advice, and business knowledge into useful content

* Creating branded graphics using Canva

* Writing clear captions and calls to action

* Suggesting content topics and maintaining a content calendar

* Directing potential clients to our website or inquiry form

* Reviewing performance and recommending practical improvements



Our content should feel trustworthy, knowledgeable, welcoming, and professional. We do not want dancing, gimmicks, aggressive sales tactics, or overly personal lifestyle content.



To Apply



Please do not send only a résumé or a general application. We need to see examples of your actual work.



Please submit:



1. Links to two or three websites you personally created or substantially helped create. Please explain exactly what work you performed on each website.

2. Links to Instagram or
 business pages you currently manage or previously managed. Please explain your responsibilities.

3. Before-and-after results, analytics, search-ranking improvements, or lead-generation results, if available.

4. Two professional references or client referrals.

5. Your hourly rate or preferred monthly retainer.

6. Your current availability and the approximate number of hours you recommend for the initial website project and ongoing monthly work.

7. A short video presentation of no more than five minutes answering this question:



“How would you create an effective internet presence for our bookkeeping firm?”



In the video, please explain:



* What you would do during the first 30 days

* How you would structure our Squarespace website

* How you would help local customers find us through Google

* What kind of weekly social media content you would create

* How you would turn website and Instagram visitors into potential client inquiries

* What information or participation you would need from the owner



Please tailor your presentation to a professional bookkeeping firm. Generic or copied marketing proposals will not be considered.



Preferred Qualifications



* Demonstrated Squarespace experience

* Strong Canva design skills

* Experience managing professional service-business accounts

* Understanding of local SEO and Google Business Profiles

* Strong written English

* Ability to create and edit short-form video

* Good organization and dependable communication

* Respect for confidentiality and professional financial-services standards



Shortlisted applicants may be offered a small paid trial project before an ongoing agreement is made.

title: Executive Assistant (Founding Team)
description:
VAI places trained, AI-fluent Filipino virtual assistants inside small US real

estate teams, and then stays in the relationship to make sure the placement

actually works. We are building the company that treats VAs the way this

industry should have all along: real employment, real training, real career

ladders, and clients who are held to standards too.



You would be **our first hire**. Not the first of a batch. The first.



That means this job is bigger than a job description can honestly contain, and

we would rather tell you that up front. You will work side by side with the

founder every day, and together you will build the machine that every future

VAI team member steps into. The training they take? You helped write it. The

hiring process they passed? You ran it. The standards they work to? You set

them by being first.



What you'll actually do



This seat is three jobs compressed into one, because that is what a founding

role is. Here are the three hats, honestly described:



1. Right hand to the founder



You keep the founder organized and moving: calendar, inbox triage, follow-up,

chasing projects to done. You sit in on calls, capture decisions, and make

sure nothing said in a meeting dies in the meeting. This is classic executive

assistant work, done at founding-team altitude, where the projects you are

chasing are the company itself.



2. Training builder



Every process you and the founder run for the first time, you document. You

turn how-we-did-it into a written SOP, and those SOPs become the training

library that certifies every VA who comes after you. You will work heavily

with AI tools to draft, structure, and maintain this material. Over time this

becomes VAI's core asset, and your fingerprints are on all of it.



3. Recruiter



You own the candidate pipeline: posting roles, screening applications, running

our multi-stage intake assessment, and keeping a warm bench of qualified

candidates so we can hire fast when a client signs. You will have been through

the funnel yourself, so you will know exactly what it feels like from the

other side.



The mix between the three hats will shift week to week, and we will be honest

with you about priorities in a daily huddle and a weekly planning session. You

will never have to guess what matters most.



You must have:**



- 2+ years supporting a US-based executive, business owner, or team remotely

  (EA, operations, or senior VA experience)

- Excellent written English. Half this job is turning messy spoken reality

  into clean written documents.

- Confident spoken English. You will be on camera with the founder daily and

  with US candidates and partners regularly.

- Real fluency with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, or similar) as part of

  how you actually work, not something you have merely tried. We will test

  this practically: can you pick up an unfamiliar AI tool from its

  documentation and make it do something useful?

- Self-management. You will often be the only person awake on your side of the

  company. You need to be someone who moves work forward without being pushed.

- A reliable setup: your own computer, stable primary internet, and a backup

  plan for power and connectivity. Brownouts happen; work continuity is part

  of the job.

- Ability to work the 8:00pm-5:00am Manila shift consistently.



**Strongly preferred (tell us if you have it):**



- US real estate experience: transaction coordination, listing coordination,

  or support work inside a US real estate team. The training material you

  build will teach real estate operations, so having done the work is a major

  advantage and will place you higher in the pay range.

- Experience writing SOPs, training material, or process documentation

- Recruiting or interviewing experience

- Familiarity with Follow Up Boss, Sierra Interactive, Lofty, or BoldTrail



Bonus:



- You have built a working AI automation, agent, or custom GPT/skill,

  anything where you configured an AI system rather than just chatted with one



Pay, benefits, and how we treat people



- $6.50-7.50/hr USD depending on experience

- Night differential paid on all hours worked between 10:00pm and 6:00am,  which on this shift is most of them

- 13th month pay, SSS, PhilHealth, and Pag-IBIG contributions from day one, without exception

- Paid holidays on a published calendar covering both US and Philippine holidays

- HMO coverage beginning at month 6 (regularization)

- Paid time off accruing from month 10

- A disaster continuity policy that treats brownouts and storms as normal operational events to plan for, not personal failures



Two things about this shift, said plainly. First, 8:00pm-5:00am is a real night shift, and we pay for it: the rate floor here sits above day-shift market rates on purpose, and night differential applies to seven of your nine hours. Second, we deliberately rejected the 10pm-7am graveyard pattern common in this industry because it wrecks people. On this schedule you still get your evening at home and you are done before dawn. Your employment agreement will note that shift hours can be adjusted with reasonable written notice as the company grows, and we will always be straight with you about why.



How we work



Compliance is not decoration: VAs at VAI never touch wire instructions, never share credentials, never do work that requires a real estate license,  and never cold-call. You will help us write these rules into training, and you will be expected to hold the line on them, including when someone senior to you asks you not to. We consider "I pushed back" a mark in your favor.

- You will have a real voice. Structured check-ins, a direct line to the founder, and, as the team grows, an anonymous channel, because we know that raising a problem can cost face and we want the problem anyway.

- AI is how we work, not a threat to your job. We are building a company where VAs manage AI systems rather than compete with them. You will be the first person trained that way, and eventually the person training others.



How to apply



Send us:



1. Your resume

2. A 2-3 minute video introducing yourself: who you are, what you have

   supported before, and why a founding seat appeals to you more than a

   settled one. Phone camera is fine. We are listening for your spoken

   English and looking for whether you are comfortable on camera, not for

   production value.

3. One short written sample: pick any process you know well, from work or

   from life, and document it as a one-page SOP that a stranger could follow.

   Use AI to help if you want; we care about the clarity of the result. This

   is a genuine preview of the training-builder part of the job.



Applications without the video and the SOP sample will not be reviewed. That

is the first test: this role belongs to someone who reads carefully and follows through.

title: Amazon UK Online Arbitrage Product Sourcing VA
description:
Amazon UK Product Sourcing Virtual Assistant (Keepa & SellerAmp SAS)



About Us



We are an Amazon UK FBA business looking for an experienced Product Sourcing Virtual Assistant to help us find profitable Online Arbitrage (OA) opportunities.



This role is 100% focused on product sourcing. You will not be responsible for customer service, listings, PPC, inventory management or account management.



We are looking for someone who is reliable, detail-oriented and experienced in using SellerAmp SAS and Keepa to find profitable products.



⸻



Responsibilities



* Source profitable products for Amazon UK FBA.

* Analyse products using SellerAmp SAS and Keepa.

* Source from legitimate UK retailers, pharmacies, wholesalers and specialist online stores.

* Look for unique sourcing opportunities, not just the most common retail websites.

* Calculate profit, ROI and Amazon fees accurately.

* Ensure the product matches the correct Amazon listing.

* Record qualified leads in Google Sheets.

* Communicate clearly and professionally.



⸻



Requirements



* Previous experience sourcing products for Amazon UK FBA.

* Strong knowledge of SellerAmp SAS.

* Strong knowledge of Keepa.

* Good understanding of Amazon FBA fees and profitability.

* Excellent product matching skills.

* Experience using Google Sheets.

* Good written English.

* Reliable internet connection.

* Strong attention to detail.



⸻



What We Are Looking For



We value:



* Quality over quantity.

* Accurate product analysis.

* Honest communication.

* Consistency.

* Initiative.

* Attention to detail.

* Ability to find products from a wide variety of legitimate UK suppliers.



⸻



Employment



* Full-time

* Remote

* Long-term opportunity



The successful candidate will first complete a 2-week paid trial. During this period we will assess:



* Accuracy of product sourcing.

* Profit and ROI calculations.

* Knowledge of SellerAmp SAS and Keepa.

* Communication.

* Reliability.

* Overall quality of work.



If the trial is successful, you will continue in the role under a 4-week probation period.



Performance reviews will take place at the end of the probation period and then every 4 weeks thereafter.



⸻



How to Apply



Please begin your application with the word:



BLACKBURN



Then answer the following questions:



1. Tell us about yourself.

2. How many years of Amazon UK sourcing experience do you have?

3. How long have you been using SellerAmp SAS?

4. How long have you been using Keepa?

5. What sourcing methods have you used? (Online Arbitrage, Wholesale, etc.)

6. Approximately how many quality leads can you source in one working day?

7. What is your expected hourly rate or monthly salary?

8. What hours are you available to work?

9. Why do you believe you are the right person for this role?



⸻



Sample Lead (Required)



Please provide ONE Amazon UK product you have previously sourced (or a similar example if the original is confidential).



Include:



* Product name

* Supplier

* Buy price

* Amazon selling price

* Estimated net profit

* ROI

* Brief explanation of why you selected the product



Bonus: Include screenshots from SellerAmp SAS and Keepa.



⸻



60-Second Introduction Video (Required)



Please record a short video (maximum 60 seconds) introducing yourself.



Please include:



* Your name.

* Your Amazon UK sourcing experience.

* Your experience using SellerAmp SAS and Keepa.

* Why you believe you are a good fit for this role.



⸻



Recruitment Process



1. Application review.

2. Short interview.

3. Review of your sample lead and 60-second video.

4. Product sourcing assessment.

5. 2-week paid trial.

6. Successful candidates will continue in a full-time role, subject to a 4-week probation period.

7. Ongoing performance reviews every 4 weeks.



⸻



Important



Applications will not be considered unless they include:



* The word BLACKBURN at the start of the application.

* A completed sample lead.

* A 60-second introduction video.



We look forward to receiving your application.

title: Fashion Dropship creatives designer and strategist
description:
Creative Designer – Fashion E-commerce



We are looking for a creative, fast and data-driven Creative Designer to join our team long-term.



We run a women’s fashion e-commerce store in the USA, mainly targeting women 50+. Every day we test new fashion products through Meta Ads, so we are looking for someone who can consistently produce high-quality creatives and, more importantly, understand why certain creatives perform better than others.



This is not just a graphic design position. We want someone who combines creativity with performance data.



What will you do?



We launch around 5–6 product campaigns per day, with approximately 5–6 creatives per product.



You will create variations such as:



Single images

Collages

Carousels

UGC-style creatives

Short-form videos

Lifestyle videos

Product-focused videos



Meta Ads Manager & Creative Analysis



You will also have access to Meta Ads Manager.



We expect you to understand and analyze metrics such as:



CPC

CPM

CTR

Add to Carts

Purchases

CPA / Cost per Purchase

ROAS



You should regularly look at the performance of the creatives you created and identify patterns.



For example, if a dress video featuring a 60+ woman walking outside performs extremely well, we want you to understand what made that combination work and create new variations around the winning concept.



At the same time, you need to understand that the exact same model and environment may not necessarily perform well for a jacket or sweater.



Our process is:



Create → Analyze → Find Winners → Double Down → Improve



The Creative Helps Find the Audience



It is also very important that you understand how Meta advertising works today.



The creative itself is an important signal Meta can use when determining who is most likely to respond to an ad.



For example, showing a 60+ woman wearing the product can help make the creative more relevant to older female shoppers, while using a 25-year-old model may appeal to a completely different audience.



That means you always need to think carefully about:



Model age

Clothing style

Environment

Lifestyle

Lighting

Product presentation

Overall visual feeling



Our main customer is an American woman aged 50+, so the creative should visually speak to that woman.



The creative isn't just about making the product look good — it needs to attract the right customer.



Who are we looking for?



Ideally, you:



Have experience with fashion/e-commerce creatives

Can create both images and videos

Understand Meta Ads Manager

Understand CPC, CPM, CTR, CPA, purchases and ROAS

Can identify winning creative patterns

Know how to double down on winners without simply copying them

Have experience with Canva, CapCut or similar tools

Are comfortable using ChatGPT and AI image/video tools

Understand realistic UGC and lifestyle content

Can work quickly and independently

Have a strong eye for detail

Understand the US 50+ female audience

Can handle a high volume of creatives every day

Are looking for a long-term position



We don't want someone who waits for instructions for every single creative.



Eventually, we want you to be able to look at a new product and think:



“This is a cardigan. Based on our previous data, I know which creative formats we should test first.”



How to Apply



Please send us:



A short introduction about yourself

Examples of images and videos you've created

Your experience with e-commerce/fashion

Your experience with Meta Ads Manager

Which AI/design/video tools you use

Your availability

Your expected hourly or monthly rate



If you've read this entire job post, start your application with:

Cobalt17

title: Patient Consultation Setter (US Dental) — $1,200–$1,600/mo + Bonus — Night Shift
description:
Salary: $1,200 to $1,600 per month, paid on the 1st and the 15th, every time. Plus $25 to $50 for every consultation that shows up. Where you land in the band depends on what we hear in your recordings, not on your resume.



Schedule: 9:00 PM to 6:00 AM Philippine time, Monday to Friday. This is a night shift. Your whole schedule inverts. If that does not work for your household, please do not apply.



Volume: 100 to 150 dials per shift.







About the work



We partner with dental practices in the United States. Our specialists are the first human contact between a patient and the practice.



You will speak with people who are anxious. They are self-conscious about their teeth. They are weighing a decision that is emotional and expensive. Many have put this call off for years.



This is not a call center seat and it is not a script. We train our people in how humans actually make decisions. Your job is to hold the wheel of the conversation with warmth.



Too soft, and the call wanders and nothing is d
. Too aggressive, and the patient shuts down. We are hiring the person who does both at once, and who does not lose composure when the conversation gets hard.



What you will do



Answer new patient inquiries fast, and build trust on the first call.

Find out what actually prompted the person to call, and what it is costing them.

Handle fear, hesitation, and price, without flinching and without pushing.

Book the consultation, then follow up by phone, text, and
 until they show.

Keep clean notes in the CRM. Every call, every time.



What we require



Real time in a sales seat. You have handled objections and carried a number. Healthcare or other high-consideration sales is a plus. The instinct matters more than the industry.

Near-native English. Clear, neutral accent. You can command a call in English at the level you could in your first language. We assess this in your recordings, not on your resume.

A quiet workspace and a stable wired connection. Mobile data and pocket WiFi will not work for this role.

Coachability. We record calls and review the hard ones together every week. If that sounds like a problem, this is not the right seat.



Pay honesty



We know this band sits above the usual setter rate on this platform. That is deliberate. We are not looking for a setter. We are looking for someone who can hold a hard conversation with a frightened adult, and we would rather pay one of those than three of something else.







HOW TO APPLY



Read all five steps. Applications that skip a step are not reviewed.



1. Record two voice clips. Use 
 — it is free, needs no account, and works on any phone. Paste both links in your application.



Clip one, 60 seconds. Tell us about the hardest call you have ever taken.

Clip two, 90 seconds. A patient says: "I want to think about it. I need to talk to my wife." Answer them. Speak as if they are on the line right now.



One take. No script. No retakes. We would rather hear the real one. We are not grading your accent. We are grading what you say next.



2. Answer these three questions in writing. Be specific. Short or generic answers do not move forward.



At your highest-volume phone job: how many dials a day, how many real conversations, and what did you do in the ten seconds right after someone hung up on you?

Tell us about one caller you still remember. What did they need that they never said out loud?

What is your current work situation, when could you start, and do you owe anyone a notice period?



3. Send a speed test. Go to speedtest.net. Change the server to Los Angeles or Dallas before you run it — a Manila server does not tell us what a patient in Phoenix hears. Run it between 9 PM and 6 AM your time. Send a screenshot showing download, upload, ping, and jitter. Tell us your connection type (fiber, cable, DSL, or mobile), whether you tested on WiFi or a cable, and what happens when the power goes out.



4. Use 15 Apply Points on this application.



5. Start your application with the words FULL ARCH so we know you read to the end.



We reply to everyone who completes all five steps.

title: Direct response video editor for DTC brand
description:
Hiring: Direct Response Video Editor (VSLs + AI Cartoon Videos and other AI style ads + Short form videos)



DTC / dropshipping brand doing ~$200k/month in revenue



Role: Video Editor / AI Video Producer Type:



Read this part first



We are not looking for someone to "make our videos look nice."



We are looking for someone who understands that a video's job is to hold attention and make people buy — and who can build that video end to end, including sourcing or generating every frame of footage inside it.



If you need a folder of assets handed to you before you can start editing, this role isn't for you. If you can take a script and a product and come back with a finished, conversion-ready asset, keep reading.



Who we are



We're a direct response DTC brand currently doing around $200k/month, almost entirely on the back of paid media and creative. Creative is our growth lever. Not the site, not the offer tweaks, not the
 flows — the video.



That means the editor seat is one of the highest-leverage roles in the company. When a video wins here, it wins loudly and you'll see it in the numbers within days.



We're scaling, and we want to stop stitching together freelancers per project. We want one highly skilled person who becomes part of the team, learns our angles and our customer inside out, and gets sharper with every batch we ship.



How this role starts (please read carefully)



This does not begin as a full-time position, and that's deliberate.



We start every editor on a lighter workload — a smaller number of videos per week — for the first stretch. Not because we're testing whether you can hold a job, but because we want to see how you fit: how you take feedback, how you handle a script we hand you, how you communicate when something's unclear, and whether the work holds up once the novelty wears off. It also gives you time to learn our customer, our angles, and what a "winning" video looks like in our account specifically.



From there it scales. As the fit proves out and your creatives start performing, the volume goes up, the pay goes up, and the arrangement moves toward a secure, permanent full-time seat — with a defined monthly retainer rather than per-project work.



To be clear about what we're offering:



Phase 1 — Fit: Lower volume, paid per project or at a smaller retainer. Heavy feedback from us. We're both figuring out if this works.

Phase 2 — Ramp: Volume increases, you take on the VSLs and the AI cartoon projects with less hand-holding, pay increases accordingly.

Phase 3 — In-house: Full-time, secure retainer, you own the creative pipeline and have real input on direction. Room to grow into a creative lead as we bring on more editors.



We're not looking for someone to fill a gap for three months. We're looking for the person who's still here in two years running our creative. The slow start is how we get there without either of us wasting the other's time.



If you need immediate full-time income from day one, this probably isn't the right fit right now — and that's fine, just be upfront about it.



What you'll actually be making

1. Long-form VSLs (Video Sales Letters)



The core of the role. 2–7+ minute sales videos built off scripts we provide.



You'll be responsible for:



Pacing the entire video so retention doesn't collapse — pattern interrupts, cuts, zooms, motion, sound design, text emphasis, visual proof

Sourcing your own b-roll. Stock libraries, licensed footage, UGC-style clips, screen recordings, archival, whatever the script calls for. You find it. You don't ask us to send it. In some cases we will also provide clips and we have a bunch of softwares that you can use to make this process easier aswell.



Generating AI video to fill the gaps stock can't cover — visualizing mechanisms, metaphors, before/after states, scenarios that don't exist as footage.



Building the visual language for a section, not just laying clips over a voiceover



Kinetic text, callouts, subtitles, on-screen proof elements, testimonial treatments



Sound design and music that carries emotional beats without burying the VO



2. AI cartoon / animated videos (short form AND long form)



We're producing a growing volume of fully AI-generated animated content — story-driven ads, explainer content, character-led narratives.



You'll take a script and:



Build a consistent character and world (this is the hard part — character consistency across dozens of shots is a real skill and we'll be testing for it)

Generate the shots yourself using AI image + video tools

Handle lip sync, voiceover, and audio

Cut it into a video that actually flows as a story rather than a slideshow of AI clips

Deliver in both short form (15–60s, vertical) and long form formats

3. Short form paid ads



Hook-first ads for Meta / TikTok. High volume, fast iteration. Multiple hook variants of the same body. You'll be cutting these constantly, and you'll be expected to have opinions about which hooks are worth testing.



What we need you to be good at



Non-negotiable:



Editing that converts, not just editing that looks good. You understand hooks, retention curves, pattern interrupts, why the first 3 seconds d
 everything, and how to build toward a CTA. If you've never thought about a video in terms of watch time or CPA, you're not ready for this seat.

Sourcing your own footage. Independently. You know where to find good b-roll,

Generating AI video yourself. Not "willing to learn" — actually doing it now. You know how to prompt, how to iterate when a generation is wrong, how to maintain consistency, and how to upscale and clean up output so it doesn't look like AI slop.

Strong technical craft — clean cuts, deliberate pacing, proper audio levels, colour that matches across mixed sources, subtitles that don't look like an afterthought.

Speed. We ship a lot. Quality at volume is the whole game.

Ownership. You get a script and a brief and come back with a finished asset. You flag problems early. You don't go quiet for four days.



Tools — you should be fluent in most of these or their equivalents:



Editing: Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut.

AI video: Higgsfield, Veo, Kling, Runway, Sora, Hailuo, Seedance — or whatever you've found works better

AI image: Midjourney, Flux, Nano Banana, Ideogram

Voice: ElevenLabs or similar

Upscaling / cleanup: Topaz, Magnific

Bonus: Descript, Adobe Podcast, motion graphics templating, basic scripting/automation for batching

Removing text from video: Vmake



Nice to have:



You've written or restructured direct response scripts before

You've worked on offers in health and wellnes niche

You can take a competitor's winning ad, break down why it works, and build a better version

You track what's new in AI video weekly because you find it genuinely interesting

Who this is NOT for

Editors who only work from supplied assets

People who see AI tools as a threat or a gimmick

"Cinematic" editors who make beautiful videos that don't sell

Anyone who needs to be chased for updates

Agencies or people who'll pass the work to a junior. We want the person doing the work.

What you get

A real seat on a growing team. We start light on purpose, but the destination is a secure full-time role — and if it works, we build our creative operation around you.

Direct feedback loop on your work. You'll see spend, retention data, and CPA on the creatives you cut. Most editors never get this — it's the fastest way to get genuinely good.

Budget for tools and subscriptions. We're not going to bottleneck you over a $50/mo AI credit plan.

Performance bonuses when your creative becomes a winner.

Room to grow into a creative lead role as we scale and bring on more editors under you.

Fast decisions. Small team. No layers of approval.

How to apply



Please follow this exactly — it's the first filter.



Send your portfolio. We want to see, specifically:

At least one long-form VSL or long-form sales video you cut

At least one AI-generated video you produced yourself (cartoon/animated preferred)

Short form paid ads if you have them

For 2–3 of those videos, tell us in one or two lines each: what the goal was, what you did to hold attention, and any performance numbers you're allowed to share (spend, ROAS, retention, CTR — whatever you have).

Tell us your AI stack. Which tools you use for what, and one problem you've solved with them that most people get wrong.

Your rate and your realistic capacity — how many long-form videos and how many short form ads per week.

Turnaround time on a typical 10-minute VSL, assuming script and VO are provided.

Confirm you're okay with the ramp-up structure — starting at lower volume and building toward full-time. One line is enough.

title: Graphic Designer (Ad Templates, Canva), Full Time, Performance Creative Agency
description:
About us

Drippl is a performance creative agency. We produce Meta 
 and Instagram) ad creatives at scale for around 15 DTC brands across Europe. Everything runs through a structured system in Notion, with tickets, briefs, and pods. We move fast and ship a high volume of ad creative every single week.



Read this before applying

This role is about ONE thing: taking proven ad templates and turning them into beautiful, on-brand designs for our clients, at high volume.



This is NOT a role for:



Logo or brand identity designers

Packaging or label designers

Illustrators

General "I design everything" graphic designers



We will only consider applications whose portfolio shows real static ad or social media designs: the kind of designs you see in a
 or Instagram feed. Portfolios with only logos, branding books, and illustrations will be rejected without review.



The role

We have a library of winning ad templates (Konvert). Your job is to take those templates and adapt them for each of our brands so the result looks like it was designed for that brand from scratch, not like a template with a logo slapped on.



You will get the copy: what to write and where it goes. Your job is the design side: transfer the brand onto the template (logo, colors, fonts, product images, overall feel), place the copy, polish it, and upload a finished, client-ready design.



Day to day you will:



Take templates from Konvert and build them out in Canva (Pro account provided)

Apply each brand's identity so the design genuinely looks and feels like that brand

Insert the provided copy exactly where the brief says

Deliver finished, ready-to-run designs, not drafts that need fixing

Produce a high volume of designs every single day at consistent quality

Work inside Notion: pick up tickets, update statuses, deliver where the brief says

Communicate in Slack: clear, fast, and proactive when something is unclear or missing

What we expect (read carefully)



High volume AND high quality. Not one or the other. You ship a lot, and it is right the first time



As few revision rounds as possible. Your first version should be client-ready. If we have to send the same design back twice, something is wrong



Speed in Canva. You know it inside out: brand kits, fonts, layers, groups, grids, resizing, exporting the right formats for Meta. If you use Canva casually, this is not for you



Sharp eye for branding. You look at a brand's assets and instantly understand its visual language, then carry it into the template so everything is consistent: exact colors, right fonts, clean spacing, correct logo use



You are a good fit if you

Have real experience designing static ads or paid social creative, and a portfolio full of it

Are genuinely good at design: strong sense of layout, typography, spacing, and visual hierarchy

Are creative and curious: you notice what makes each brand look great and push the design further than "technically correct"

Understand what makes a paid ad work: clear product focus, readable at thumbnail size, built to convert, not just to look pretty

Read briefs carefully and follow them precisely, and ask a sharp question BEFORE designing when something is unclear, instead of guessing wrong

Can produce high output at consistent quality, day after day

Communicate clearly in written English and flag problems early in Slack

Are reliable and consistent. This is a "show up every day and ship" role



Bonus points

Experience at a performance marketing / DTC / e-commerce agency shipping paid social creative

Experience with template systems like Konvert (or similar)

Experience in a ticket-based production environment (Notion, ClickUp, Asana)

You've seen performance data on your ads (CTR, ROAS) and iterated based on it

Basic Photoshop or Figma skills for the occasional asset cleanup



Details

Full time: 40 hours per week

Fixed monthly rate, paid in USD, on time every month

Canva Pro account provided

Long-term role with room to grow as we scale the team

Location: [Philippines]

Timezone: [overlap needed, e.g. a few hours of CET overlap per day]

Send your portfolio + expected monthly salary to my WhatsApp:

title: E-commerce/DTC Video Editor, For Ads (Full Time)
description:
Performance-focused. AI-augmented. Long-term.



We run paid media at scale for DTC and e-commerce brands across European markets, and we're looking for an editor who gets the why behind every cut, not just the how.



This isn't a role for someone who waits for a brief and assembles clips. We need someone who can watch raw footage and know instinctively which B-roll makes the hook land, who understands that the wrong cutaway kills a conversion and the right one doubles watch time. If you've ever paused an ad you liked just to reverse-engineer why it worked, keep reading.



The basics

Type: Full-time (40 hours per week)

Location: Remote

Compensation: [800-1,200] USD/month

Start: ASAP

Output: 3-4 finished edits per day

What you'll own

Edit short-form ad creative for Meta and TikTok: fast, punchy, conversion-oriented

Choose and sequence B-roll with intent. Every clip serves the hook, reinforces the claim, or deepens the emotional pull

Build visual hooks that stop the scroll. You know the first 1-2 seconds are the entire game

Cut UGC, founder, and testimonial footage into structured formats (Hook, Problem, Mechanism, CTA)

Generate AI video assets in Higgsfield and similar tools: realistic, on-brand footage that blends seamlessly with real clips

Produce modular assets that repurpose cleanly across placements and audiences

Non-negotiables

Proven DTC/e-commerce ad editing. You've edited ads that actually ran on Meta or TikTok for real brands. You understand pacing curves, attention drop-off, and how to build an edit around a conversion goal, not just aesthetics.



Intentional B-roll selection. You don't fill gaps, you amplify the script. You know when a reaction shot beats a product shot, and when on-screen text does more work than either.



Visual hook creation. You think visually first. You can concept and execute an opening that creates immediate pattern interruption, without leaning on the script to carry it.



Higgsfield + AI fluency. You're already comfortable prompting and generating realistic AI video, and you know how to make Higgsfield output that doesn't read as AI. We provide advanced internal training, but you need a real foundation to build on.



Strong English comprehension. Most scripts and voiceovers are in English. You need to catch nuance, not just words, so your edit rhythm matches what's being said and why.



Comfortable in Notion. We run briefs, trackers, and feedback through Notion. You don't need to be a power user, but you need to work inside it day to day without friction.



Nice to have

VSL or long-form ad formats for cold traffic

Direct response frameworks (AIDA, PAS, and similar)

Other AI video tools beyond Higgsfield (Kling, Runway, Pika)

Working knowledge of Meta ad structure: formats, ratios, placements

Who fits here

You think like a marketer, not just a creative. You care about what converts

You bring ideas and push back on a brief when you see a better angle

You ship final-ready work, not "almost there"

Fast iteration energizes you; it doesn't slow you down

You're driven and you work hard. You take pride in output and don't need to be chased

You want to be part of a team, not a solo freelancer. You communicate, share wins, and lift the people around you

You're honest and loyal. We'd rather hear the hard truth early than a polished excuse late, and we build long-term with people who do the same

What we offer

This is a long-term seat, not a gig. We invest in the people who commit to us:



Access to a premium AI tool stack (HeyGen, Higgsfield, ElevenLabs, and more), all on us, so you're never limited by what you can produce

Advanced internal training on our editing systems, AI workflows, and direct response frameworks. You'll get better at this here than almost anywhere else

A real growth path: clear room to take on more ownership, scope, and responsibility as you prove yourself

A team that values honesty and loyalty. We're direct with each other, we back the people who back us, and we keep the people who grow with us

How to apply

Send your portfolio (3-5 ad edits you're proud of, DTC/e-commerce strongly preferred) + expected monthly salary to my WhatsApp: 
If the requirements are not sent, you will be ignored.

title: Sourcing / Product Development Manager
description:
Sourcing / Product Development Manager



Full-time | Remote



Are you looking for a role that allows you to use your creativity and problem-solving skills in real life?

We are a UK-based e-commerce company operating in the USA and UK, with two core physical product niches and clear product values that guide everything we create.



You will research new product ideas based on these guidelines and, once an idea is approved, develop it and push it into a real-life product that genuinely helps people.



Do you get a thrill from finding great suppliers, negotiating with factories and developing products?

You will be responsible for building our 12–18 month product pipeline and will have a big part in bringing our next generation of products to life. Our goal is to launch 10 new products over the next 12 months, while also constantly looking at our current products and asking: what could be better, what are customers missing and what problems can we solve?

You will be very hands-on throughout the whole process — from researching ideas and finding suppliers, to developing samples, working with product designers, negotiating with factories, optimising product costs and getting the final product into production.



You will also be responsible for monitoring product quality by coordinating third-party quality inspection companies and ensuring they have everything they need to properly inspect our products.

Every month, you will carefully analyse customer feedback and quality issues to identify opportunities for improvement. You will work directly with suppliers through regular problem-solving conversations via Zoom and WeChat, as well as analyse new product samples and improvements together with the CEO.



You will also lead projects for our products to be safety tested and submitted into relevant award competitions.



Other parts of the role will include:

Product research and idea development

Finding and evaluating new suppliers and factories

Product development and sample management

Packaging development with designers

Product cost optimisation

Factory negotiations

Customer feedback and product improvement

Product quality monitoring and third-party inspections

Working with product designers

Managing the product development pipeline



We are a remote female team and we do not do graveyard hours.

Do you want to work with a fantastic team that you can also learn from? Each person on our team has been carefully selected and their role adapted to suit their strengths. We are a team that takes our work seriously, moves quickly and wants to keep improving.

The company also supports all team members in getting access to the best training courses in their industry, so you can continue developing your skills and stay up to date with the latest information and knowledge.



E-commerce experience is a must.

Some IP knowledge is preferable but not a must.

Competitive salary based on experience.

If you are someone who is hands-on, commercially minded, fast-moving and genuinely excited by creating products, we would love to hear from you.



Message us:



1. Your resume

2. Share 2–3 products you personally developed, including your role and the outcome.

3. Share one example of a problem you identified and solved before it became a larger issue.

title: E-Commerce Specialist — Shopify & Klaviyo
description:
I’m the Founder & CEO of AceFit Tennis Life, and I’m looking for the right person to help me build out the e-commerce side of the brand.



AceFit is still in the early stages, but I’m very confident in where I’m taking it and the bigger vision behind what we’re building.



We’re building a health and wellness brand for the tennis community, starting with hydration and expanding into intentional products, resources, community, and courtside experiences that bring wellness closer to the game. Long term, I see AceFit growing beyond tennis and serving other sports communities as well.



Because I’m building this from the ground up, I’m looking for more than someone who simply knows how to complete a list of e-commerce tasks.



I want someone who takes the time to look at AceFit, understands what we’re building, and genuinely feels excited about the opportunity to be part of it early.



What I'm looking for 



The right person should be very comfortable with:



• Shopify management, optimization, product pages, landing pages, apps, and integrations



• Klaviyo setup,
 flows, campaigns, segmentation, and automation



• Conversion optimization and improving the customer journey



•
 capture, retention, and repeat purchases



• Subscriptions, bundles, reviews, loyalty, and other e-commerce tools



• Tracking, analytics, and general e-commerce troubleshooting



Experience with supplement, wellness, nutrition, or CPG brands is very important. Our first product, AceFit Hydrate™, is an ingestible product, so I’m looking for someone who understands that supplement e-commerce requires additional care around FDA/FTC-conscious marketing, claims, product information, and customer communication.



You don’t have to know everything. I’d rather find someone who is great at what they do, knows what they don’t know, and is willing to research, learn, and bring ideas to the table.



More than just a task list. 



I’m building a team of people with different strengths, and I want the people I invest in to feel connected to what we’re building.



Of course, this is a professional paid working relationship and I respect the value of someone’s time and expertise. But I’m also looking for someone who brings ideas, creativity, ownership, and genuine excitement to the journey rather than simply waiting for the next task.



I’d like to start out and to see how well we work together and how well you understand the brand. If it’s a strong fit on both sides, there is absolutely room for the relationship and responsibilities to grow as AceFit grows.



I know where I want to take AceFit. I’m looking for talented people who would be excited to help me build the pieces that get us there.



If you take a look at AceFit and feel like this is something you’d genuinely love to be part of building, I’d love to hear from you.



Please share your experience with Shopify, Klaviyo, and supplement/wellness e-commerce, examples of stores you’ve worked on, and most importantly, what stood out to you about AceFit after looking at the brand.



Lindar Hebert 

AceFit Tennis Life

Ace Your Health. Ace Your Game.

title: Paid Media Campaign Manager / Performance Marketer/ AI Automation & Google Firebase Builder
description:
## About Pro Manager



Pro Manager provides outsourced management services in marketing, sales, technology, and operations to growing businesses.



We are looking for a highly organized, hands-on Paid Media Campaign Manager to support the execution and optimization of client campaigns.



This is an execution-focused role. You will receive an approved brief, campaign objective, copy, graphics, and videos — then build, track, optimize, and report on campaigns across multiple platforms.



You are not expected to create the marketing strategy, produce video content, or serve as a general marketing manager. Your responsibility is to make campaigns run accurately, efficiently, and measurably.



## Main Responsibilities



* Build, launch, manage, and optimize paid campaigns for lead generation, e-commerce sales, and, when relevant, app installs.

* Work across Meta Ads, Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Taboola, TikTok Ads, and YouTube.

* Set up campaign structure, audiences, placements, budgets, bidding strategies, ad variations, and conversion goals according to the approved brief.

* Upload approved ads, copy, images, videos, and landing-page links accurately.

* Perform daily campaign checks and ongoing optimization based on performance data.

* Identify underperforming ads, audiences, placements, keywords, or landing pages and recommend clear actions.

* Monitor budgets, pacing, disapprovals, learning limitations, tracking issues, and lead volume.

* Create and maintain UTM parameters, campaign naming conventions, and clean tracking structures.

* Prepare a clear weekly report for every client, including performance, KPI status, insights, actions completed, and next optimization steps.

* Publish and schedule approved organic content across social channels, including
, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, and YouTube.

* Upload content and basic updates to Shopify, WordPress, and Wix websites and landing pages.

* Support conversion-rate optimization through Hotjar reviews, including recordings, heatmaps, friction points, and clear improvement recommendations.



## Required Advertising Platforms



* Meta Ads Manager:
 and Instagram

* Google Ads: Search, Display, Performance Max, YouTube, and lead-generation campaigns

* LinkedIn Campaign Manager

* Taboola Ads — proven hands-on experience is mandatory

* TikTok Ads Manager



Applicants with Taboola experience must be able to present anonymized live campaign results during the interview, including campaign objective, spend range, CPL/CPA or ROAS, optimization actions, and outcome.



## Tracking & Technical Requirements



* Google Tag Manager

* Google Analytics 4

* Google Search Console

* Meta Pixel and Conversion API

* Google Ads conversion tracking and enhanced conversions

* TikTok Pixel

* LinkedIn Insight Tag

* Taboola Pixel

* Event and conversion setup for forms, phone clicks, WhatsApp clicks, purchases, thank-you pages, and lead submissions

* UTM tracking and source attribution

* Ability to diagnose basic tracking discrepancies between ad platforms, GA4, CRM, and website forms

* Hotjar: heatmaps, session recordings, funnel analysis, and practical CRO recommendations



## Website & Content Operations



* Uploading and formatting content on Shopify, WordPress, and Wix

* Creating and updating basic landing-page sections, forms, buttons, links, and thank-you pages

* Scheduling and publishing approved content on social media and YouTube

* Basic YouTube Studio management: uploads, titles, descriptions, tags, thumbnails, playlists, and promotion



## Weekly Reporting Standard



Every client report must include:



* Spend by platform

* Impressions, clicks, CTR, CPM, CPC

* Leads, CPL, MQL/SQL where available

* Meetings, sales, revenue, ROAS, CAC where data is available

* Performance against the agreed KPI

* Best- and worst-performing campaigns, ads, audiences, and keywords

* Optimizations completed during the week

* Issues requiring attention

* Clear actions planned for the following week



## Must-Have Requirements

* At least 2–3 years of hands-on paid media experience.

* Proven experience managing lead-generation and e-commerce campaigns.

* Strong practical experience with Meta Ads and Google Ads.

* Proven Taboola experience with real campaign results available for review.

* Practical experience with LinkedIn Ads and TikTok Ads.

* Strong knowledge of GTM, GA4, pixels, conversion tracking, UTM parameters, and event setup.

* Experience working with Shopify, WordPress, and Wix.

* Ability to analyze performance data and make practical optimization decisions.

* Strong written English and reliable daily communication.

* Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage several client accounts simultaneously.



## Nice to Have



* Experience with CRM systems and source attribution.

* Experience with Google Sheets reporting dashboards.

* Experience with Looker Studio.

* Experience with WhatsApp conversion tracking.

* Experience with app-install campaigns.

* Experience working with agencies or multiple clients simultaneously.



## Important



* This is not a content-creator, video-editor, web-developer, or marketing-manager position.

* The candidate will receive campaign briefs and creative assets from the Pro Manager team.

* The candidate must execute campaigns accurately, protect tracking integrity, optimize based on data, and provide consistent weekly reports. Position Overview



Pro Manager is looking for a hands-on AI Automation & Google Firebase Builder to support our internal operations and client delivery.



This is an execution-focused role. You will turn clear business requirements into working automations, internal tools, dashboards, and AI-powered workflows for marketing, sales, and operations.



You will work directly with the management team. We define the business goal and workflow logic; you build, test, document, and maintain the solution.



Core Technology Stack



- Google AI Studio and Gemini API

- Firebase: Firestore, Authentication, Cloud Functions, Hosting, Storage and Security Rules

- n8n for automation workflows

- Claude Code for coding, debugging, documentation, and implementation support

- Google Workspace: Google Sheets, Gmail, Drive, Calendar and Apps Script

- REST APIs, Webhooks, OAuth, JSON and third-party integrations

- GitHub and Git-based version control

- JavaScript / TypeScript and Node.js



Responsibilities



- Build internal web tools and lightweight applications using Google AI Studio, Firebase and Gemini.

- Create and maintain n8n workflows for lead management, notifications, reporting, task management, and operational processes.

- Connect forms, websites, CRM platforms, Google Workspace tools, WhatsApp Business API, advertising platforms, and external APIs.

- Build AI-assisted workflows for sales, marketing, customer service, and internal operations.

- Create dashboards, alerts, automated reports, and data-validation processes.

- Test every implementation before release and fix bugs quickly.

- Maintain clean documentation: purpose, workflow, credentials ownership, integrations, and troubleshooting steps.

- Improve existing workflows based on feedback from the management team.



Must-Have Requirements



- Proven hands-on experience with Google AI Studio and Gemini API.

- Proven Firebase experience: Firestore, Authentication, Cloud Functions, Hosting, Storage, and Security Rules.

- Strong n8n experience, including API integrations, webhooks, error handling, retries, and logging.

- Practical experience using Claude Code for development and debugging.

- Strong JavaScript / TypeScript and Node.js skills.

- Experience with Google Sheets, Apps Script, Gmail, Drive, and Calendar integrations.

- Experience with REST APIs, JSON, OAuth, Webhooks, and third-party systems.

- Ability to read existing code, fix issues, deploy changes, and document work clearly.

- Good written English and reliable daily communication.



Nice to Have



- WhatsApp Business API / Meta integrations.

- Experience with Zoho, HubSpot, Monday, ClickUp, or similar CRM/project-management tools.

- React or Next.js.

- Experience creating internal admin dashboards.

- Experience working with marketing or sales teams.



Important



GoHighLevel is not part of our technology stack and is not required for this role.
