title: Youtube, AI Video Editor and Social Media Growth Assistant
description:
AI Video Editor and Social Media Growth Assistant



**Company:** Trips & Ships Luxury Travel

**Location:** Remote

**Schedule:** 40 hours per week

**Compensation:** $3 USD per hour

**Start Date:** Immediately



About Trips & Ships Luxury Travel



Trips & Ships Luxury Travel is a growing luxury travel agency and host agency serving travelers and professional travel advisors throughout the United States.



The company is led by CEO and founder Angela Hughes, a luxury travel expert who has traveled to more than 121 countries. Angela is an adjunct professor of geography and travel and tourism and was named one of TravelPulse’s Most Influential Women in Travel for 2026.



Angela is also building a personal brand centered on luxury travel, cruises, destinations, firsthand experiences and honest advice that helps people make better travel decisions.



Our goal is to make Angela Hughes and Trips & Ships Luxury Travel one of the most visible and trusted travel resources across YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Google and AI-powered search platforms.



Our Number-One Goal



Your number-one responsibility will be growing our YouTube, TikTok and Instagram channels through high-quality, searchable and visually compelling video content.



We also want Angela and Trips & Ships Luxury Travel to be found when travelers ask questions through Google, ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews and other AI-powered answer engines.



We are not looking for fake followers, purchased engagement or empty views. We want to build a genuine, organic audience of qualified travelers who trust Angela, engage with our content, visit our website and ultimately purchase travel from us.



About the Position



We are looking for a creative, organized and highly proactive **AI Video Editor and Social Media Growth Assistant**.



This is not simply a social media posting position.



You will research the top travel questions people are asking online and help us turn those questions into modern, intriguing and beautifully edited videos featuring Angela’s firsthand knowledge, strong opinions and personality.



You will work directly with Angela and her assistant to keep content research, filming, editing and publishing organized and on schedule.



We need someone who brings ideas, takes ownership and keeps the process moving without waiting to be told what to do every day.



What You Will Do



* Research the most frequently asked travel questions on Google, YouTube, TikTok, Reddit and AI platforms

* Identify questions that indicate someone may be preparing to book a luxury trip or cruise

* Develop video topics based on real search demand

* Write strong hooks, titles, talking points and scripts

* Help turn Angela’s travel experiences into interesting stories

* Edit long-form YouTube videos using relevant B-roll

* Use Claude, Higgsfield, Nano Banana and other AI creative tools

* Create YouTube Shorts, TikToks and Instagram Reels

* Repurpose each major video for multiple platforms

* Select the strongest moments from raw footage

* Match Angela’s talking-head videos with relevant travel B-roll

* Add captions, graphics, music, sound effects and transitions

* Create thumbnails and video cover images

* Write video descriptions, captions, keywords and calls to action

* Optimize videos for search, watch time, retention and conversion

* Upload and schedule approved content

* Organize footage by destination, experience and content topic

* Maintain weekly and monthly content calendars

* Track each idea from research through filming, editing and publication

* Review channel analytics and identify what is working

* Connect content performance with website traffic, inquiries and sales

* Recommend what Angela should film next



Can You Make Our Videos Look Amazing?



Strong video-editing skills are required.



We have extensive travel footage, photographs, destination experiences and expert knowledge. We need someone who can transform those assets into polished, modern and trend-aware videos that people want to watch.



You must be able to:



* Create strong visual hooks within the opening seconds

* Edit for pacing and audience retention

* Remove pauses, mistakes and unnecessary content

* Add professional captions and dynamic on-screen text

* Incorporate maps, photographs and supporting graphics

* Use music and sound design to create emotion

* Improve audio and remove distracting background noise

* Apply tasteful color correction and visual enhancements

* Create modern transitions and motion graphics

* Format videos correctly for each platform

* Create intriguing thumbnails without using misleading clickbait

* Make Angela look and sound natural, credible and professional

* Maintain a modern, elevated luxury-travel appearance



Our videos should feel:



* Modern

* Trendy

* Polished

* Visually beautiful

* Intelligent

* Personal

* Aspirational

* Trustworthy

* Consistent with a respected luxury travel brand



We want viewers to stop because the video looks beautiful, continue watching because the story is compelling and contact us because they trust the expertise behind it.



Search-Led Video Strategy



Before creating a video, you will research what travelers are actively asking online.



Examples may include:



* What is the best month to visit Italy?

* How much does a luxury trip to Italy really cost?

* Which European river cruise line is best?

* Is a cruise ship balcony worth the extra money?

* Should I visit Santorini or Mykonos?

* Is a guided tour better than planning Europe independently?

* What happens when river levels are too low?

* What is the best cruise line for travelers over 60?

* Is using a luxury travel advisor worth it?

* How far in advance should I book a luxury vacation?



Every video should include:



1. A high-interest travel question

2. A powerful opening hook

3. Angela’s direct answer

4. A personal story, example or honest opinion

5. Useful information viewers can apply

6. Beautiful and relevant visual support

7. A reason to trust Angela and Trips & Ships Luxury Travel

8. A natural call to action that can lead to an inquiry or sale



Our goal is to create the most useful, authoritative and engaging video answer available for each carefully selected question.



 Using AI Creatively



We want to maximize AI without producing content that feels fake, generic or mass-produced.



You may use AI to:



* Research popular travel questions

* Identify emerging topics and related searches

* Develop story angles and opening hooks

* Create initial script drafts

* Generate title and thumbnail concepts

* Find the strongest moments within raw footage

* Organize and categorize our content library

* Create maps, animations and supporting graphics

* Improve audio and video quality

* Add accurate captions

* Repurpose content for multiple platforms

* Analyze performance and recommend future topics

* Make our production process faster and more consistent



AI should make our real stories more intriguing and beautiful. It should never be used to fabricate destinations, hotels, cruise ships or experiences that Angela has not visited.



All final content must sound like Angela and reflect the personality, experience and credibility of the Trips & Ships brand.



## Organic Growth That Converts



We are not interested in appearing popular simply for the sake of appearance.



We would rather have 10,000 qualified followers who watch, trust and buy than 100,000 followers who never engage or convert.



Our content should:



* Attract travelers actively researching luxury travel and cruises

* Answer questions people ask before making a purchase

* Build trust through Angela’s firsthand experience

* Encourage viewers to visit our website

* Grow our
 audience

* Generate qualified travel inquiries

* Introduce professional travel advisors to our host agency

* Nurture people who may not be ready to purchase immediately

* Create a measurable path from viewer to client



Success will be evaluated through organic audience growth, watch time, returning viewers, audience retention, website traffic, qualified inquiries and sales, not follower count alone.



## Working With Angela and Her Assistant



Angela travels extensively and manages a growing company. You must proactively work with Angela and her assistant to keep filming and production on track.



You will be expected to:



* Bring researched content ideas to Angela each week

* D
 which videos should be prioritized

* Prepare hooks, scripts and talking points before filming

* Work with Angela’s assistant to schedule filming sessions

* Provide clear weekly filming lists

* Prepare destination-specific filming plans before Angela travels

* Create B-roll and photography shot lists

* Send reminders and follow up when footage or approvals are needed

* Help Angela batch-record content

* Recognize timely filming opportunities while Angela is traveling

* Organize completed footage and move it quickly into editing

* Maintain a production pipeline so the team works ahead

* Use performance data to d
 what Angela should film next



You should be comfortable saying:



“These are the three videos we need to film this week. Here is why each topic matters, what viewers are asking and exactly what we need from you.”



## Required Skills



* Strong written and spoken English

* Proven video-editing ability

* Experience creating short-form social media videos

* Understanding of YouTube, TikTok and Instagram

* Ability to write strong hooks and titles

* Experience using AI for research and content creation

* Familiarity with CapCut, Canva, Adobe Premiere Pro or similar tools

* Experience with Claude, Higgsfield, Nano Banana or comparable AI creative platforms

* Strong storytelling and visual judgment

* Excellent research and organizational skills

* Ability to follow brand guidelines

* Ability to meet deadlines and work independently

* Willingness to accept feedback and revise content

* Reliable internet access and computer equipment

* Consistent communication during agreed working hours



## Preferred Experience



* Travel, tourism, cruising or hospitality content

* Long-form YouTube editing

* YouTube thumbnails and channel optimization

* SEO, AEO and keyword research

* Managing a founder-led personal brand

* Google Analytics and Google Search Console

* Content calendars and project-management systems

* Social media analytics and performance reporting



## Who Will Succeed in This Position?



You may be a strong fit if you are creative, curious, resourceful and proactive.



You understand that beautiful travel footage is not enough. A successful video needs the right question, a compelling hook, strong pacing, an interesting story and a clear reason for the viewer to take the next step.



You follow video and social media trends, but you do not blindly copy them. You know how to adapt modern formats so they feel appropriate for a sophisticated luxury travel brand.

title: Email & Retention Marketer (Klaviyo) - Subscription Food Brand, EU
description:
Paldy is a high-protein, low-sugar cereal brand selling across 20+ EU markets on Shopify, with subscriptions running on Skio and
 on Klaviyo. People buy in bundles of 4, 6 or 8 boxes, and a good chunk of them subscribe.



Acquisition is not our problem. Getting the second order is. That is the job.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Own Klaviyo end to end: flows, campaigns, segments, templates

- Build and fix lifecycle flows that move customers from order 1 to order 2 to order 3

- Work with subscription data from Skio: upcoming charges, skips, cancellations, credits

- Localise sends across 20 languages, so the right market gets the right language

- Read the numbers weekly and change what is not working, including killing your own campaigns



YOU ARE A FIT IF

- You have run Klaviyo for a real ecommerce brand, not just built templates in one

- You have designed flows yourself, not only inherited someone else's account

- You can look at a flow and say in euros why it is worth fixing before you touch it

- You write clean English
 copy that sounds like a person

- Subscription or repeat-purchase experience is a big plus



YOU ARE NOT A FIT IF your experience is cold outreach, lead-gen blasting, or B2B newsletters.



----------



HOW TO APPLY (applications that skip a step are not reviewed)



Do not send a CV on its own. We want to see you think. Write the plan below, put it in a Google Doc or a PDF, and
 it to us. There is no separate test stage. This is the application.



THE SITUATION

We sell high-protein, low-sugar cereal in 20+ EU markets. Shopify for the store, Skio for subscriptions, Klaviyo for
, Richpanel for support. People buy in bundles of 4, 6 or 8 boxes, and a good share of them subscribe at checkout. Five flavours are live and a new one is spotlighted every month. Customers sit across 20 languages.



Here is our actual problem: we are good at getting the first order and bad at getting the second. That is the gap we want you to attack.



WRITE US A PLAN, MAX 3 PAGES, COVERING:



1. PRIORITIES IN EUROS. The three flows you would fix or build FIRST, each with a rough revenue case. Not "every brand needs a welcome flow." Show the arithmetic, even on assumed numbers.



2. BUILD ONE OF THEM. Your top pick, laid out fully: every message, timing between them, who enters, who exits, what each message is for. Say where subscribers and one-time buyers should be treated differently.



3. WRITE
 1 IN FULL. Subject line, preview text, body copy, one single call to action. Written to send, not described.



4. THE SAVE PATH. A subscriber clicks cancel. What do they see and receive, and what do you offer instead of money off?



5. THE VERDICT. One metric that tells you in 30 days it worked, and the number at which you would call it a failure and stop.



6. ONE PARAGRAPH on how you would handle this flow going out in 20 languages.



7. ONE PARAGRAPH on which AI tools you used here, what they produced, and what you rewrote.



RULES

- No discount codes and no percentage-off offers anywhere in your plan. We do not discount, ever. Pricing is structural: buy a bigger bundle, the per-bowl price drops. Same price every day of the year. If your retention plan needs a coupon to work, it is the wrong plan.

-
 only, unless you justify another channel in one sentence.

- EU food law applies. No health cures, no weight loss promises. You may say healthy, high protein, low sugar, gluten free.

- We have not given you our numbers. Where you need one, state your assumption clearly and build from it. We are judging your reasoning, not whether you guess our figures.

- Nothing needs to be built in Klaviyo. We want a decision-ready plan.



ALSO INCLUDE IN THE SAME

- The ESP accounts you have actually owned, and roughly the list size of each.

- 2 to 3 sentences on one flow or campaign you killed or rebuilt because the data said so.

- A 1 to 2 minute video introducing yourself. Unlisted YouTube, Loom or Drive link. No script needed, no editing. We do not review applications without it.



Subject line:
 - [your name]



Send it to: 



Write the plan down and send it to us. We will get back to you.

The CRM is already substantially built and functional. I have been developing it myself using Claude Code, but I no longer have enough time to finish the remaining features, testing and polish.



Your job will be to take over the existing project, understand the current codebase, and use Claude Code to efficiently bring the CRM to a production-ready state.



## What You'll Be Doing



- Review and understand the existing CRM and codebase

- Work through a clear list of remaining features and issues

- Use Claude Code extensively to develop and troubleshoot

- Test features properly rather than simply accepting AI-generated code

- Fix bugs and edge cases

- Improve existing functionality where required

- Commit changes cleanly using Git

- Keep the existing architecture unless there is a genuine reason to change it

- Provide a short daily update showing what has been completed and any blockers



The goal is simple:



**Finish the CRM, make sure it works properly, and get it ready for everyday business use.**



## Who We're Looking For



You do NOT need to be a senior software engineer.



I am more interested in someone who is:



- Very comfortable using Claude Code

- Technically capable and able to understand an existing codebase

- Good at debugging

- Comfortable with Git/GitHub

- Able to test their own work

- Resourceful and able to solve problems independently

- Detail-oriented

- Reliable and communicative

- Comfortable taking ownership of a project and pushing it through to completion



Experience building internal tools, dashboards, CRMs or business applications is a big advantage.



## Important



We are specifically looking for someone who **actually uses Claude Code for development**, rather than someone who has only experimented with ChatGPT or other AI tools.



You should understand how to give Claude Code context, work through larger tasks, review its changes, debug problems, and prevent it from making unnecessary changes to an existing application.



## Initial Project

You will receive:



- Access to the existing codebase

- An explanation of how the CRM currently works

- A list of remaining requirements

- Guidance on the intended finished product



From there, I want someone who can take ownership and make progress without needing constant supervision.



There may be ongoing development and automation work available for the right person after the CRM is completed.



## How to Apply

3. Describe the most complicated project you have completed with Claude Code.

6. What is your experience with Git/GitHub?

title: Personal Brand Manager + Executive Assistant
description:
ABOUT US



We're a UK investment company led by a founder with a growing public profile — author, investor, active on LinkedIn. The brand drives the business: it's how deals, press, and opportunities find us. Your job is to run the machine behind it so the founder only does the things only he can do.



You'll report directly to the founder. Small team, fast-moving, long-term role — we want someone who grows with us over years, not months.



THE ROLE



One person, three hats:



1. LinkedIn & Personal Brand (50%)



Own the content calendar: schedule posts from the founder's drafts and voice notes, keep the pipeline full

Repurpose content: turn long posts into shorter ones, pull quotes into Canva graphics (to our brand guidelines — templates provided)

Manage the inbox: triage DMs and connection requests daily, flag high-value conversations, draft replies for approval

Engagement: monitor comments on our posts and draft responses; track target accounts we should be engaging with

Report weekly: followers, impressions, top posts, DM conversations opened



2. PR & Visibility (20%)



Monitor Qwoted (and similar journalist-request platforms) daily for relevant opportunities

Draft pitches in the founder's voice for his approval — speed matters, these expire fast

Track placements and maintain an up-to-date press kit and bio



3. Executive Assistant (30%)



Morning briefing prepared before the UK day starts (you're 7 hours ahead — use it)

Diary management: protect focus blocks, schedule calls, chase confirmations

Track open commitments — his and yours — and chase them until closed

End-of-day report: what shipped, what's stuck, what needs a decision

Ad-hoc research and document prep



The golden rule: you draft, he approves. Nothing is published or sent in the founder's name without his sign-off. As trust builds, you'll earn autonomy — but his voice is the asset, and we protect it.



MUST-HAVES



2+ years managing LinkedIn or social presence for a founder, executive, or personal brand — with results you can show

Exceptional written English. You'll be drafting in a UK founder's voice for an audience of UK business owners — samples will be required and tested

Canva proficiency (working to an existing brand guide)

Scheduling/analytics tools: Taplio, Hypefury, Buffer, Shield, or similar

Rock-solid discretion — you'll see deals, numbers, and conversations that stay private

Self-managing: you flag problems with a proposed fix, not just the problem

Stable internet, backup power/connection, quiet workspace



NICE-TO-HAVES



Qwoted, HARO/Connectively, or Featured pitching experience

Newsletter tools (Beehiiv, Substack, Mailchimp)

Basic video editing (CapCut/Descript) for repurposing

Zapier/Make/n8n

Experience supporting an executive's calendar and inbox



HOURS



Monday–Friday, 8 hours/day. Mostly your daytime (PH), but your shift must run until at least 6:00 PM Philippine time so we get a live handover during the UK morning. Weekends are yours.



PAY & BENEFITS



13th month pay

Paid Philippine public holidays + paid leave after probation

Performance review at 6 months with a raise path

Stable, long-term role with one employer



HOW TO APPLY



Attention to detail and writing ability ARE the job. So:



Put the word SIGNAL as the first word of your application.

Answer these three questions (short answers, no essays):



Link to a LinkedIn account or personal brand you've managed — or describe what you did and the results, with numbers.

Writing test: a business owner comments on one of our posts: "Interesting, but I'd never sell my company to an investor." Write the 2–3 sentence reply you'd draft for the founder.



What time (PH) would you prefer to start and finish?



Include a 2-minute Loom or video introducing yourself in English — talk about brands and executives you've supported, not your life story.



Attach your CV and 2–3 writing samples (posts, DMs, or pitches you've written for someone else).

title: Senior Australian Public Practice Bookkeeper | Remote Independent Contractor – Philippines
description:
Senior Australian Public Practice Bookkeeper

Remote Independent Contractor – Philippines





Location: Philippines – 100% Remote

Engagement Type: Long-term Independent Contractor

Service Days: Monday to Friday

Reports To: Australian Client Manager

Client Contact: No direct client communication required



About the Role



We are an Australian accounting practice seeking an experienced Senior Australian Public Practice Bookkeeper based in the Philippines to support a portfolio of Australian clients.

This is a hands-on, non-client-facing role. You will work directly with an Australian Client Manager, who will manage all external client communication and provide instructions, priorities and review feedback.



You will be responsible for delivering accurate bookkeeping, payroll, BAS/IAS preparation, reconciliations, month-end work and accounting support across multiple Australian entities.

This opportunity is suitable only for candidates with substantial recent experience working within, or directly supporting, an Australian accounting firm, bookkeeping practice or public practice environment.



Key ResponsibilitiesBookkeeping and Reconciliations

· Manage end-to-end bookkeeping for multiple Australian clients.

· Complete bank, credit card, loan and merchant facility reconciliations.

· Reconcile payment platforms such as Stripe, Square, PayPal, Shopify and Wise.

· Process accounts payable and accounts receivable.

· Process supplier bills, sales invoices, credit notes, refunds and payments.

· Review aged receivables and aged payables.

· Process journals, accruals, prepayments and accounting adjustments.

· Reconcile director, shareholder, beneficiary and intercompany loan accounts.

· Maintain fixed asset registers and assist with depreciation schedules.

· Investigate unreconciled, duplicated, missing or incorrectly recorded transactions.



Account Code and GST Code Review



This is a senior-level role. You must be able to review the quality and technical accuracy of bookkeeping work.



You will be required to:



· Review and correct account codes.

· Review and correct GST tax codes.

· Identify incorrect use of GST on Income, GST on Expenses, GST-Free, Input Taxed and BAS Excluded codes.

· Review the GST treatment of overseas transactions, exports, reimbursements, disbursements, insurance payments and government grants.

· Identify personal, capital, private and non-deductible transactions.

· Review general ledger accounts for unusual balances and incorrect classifications.

· Review suspense, clearing and uncategorised transaction accounts.

· Self-review all work before submitting it to the Client Manager.

· Review work prepared by junior bookkeepers where required.



Australian Payroll



· Process weekly, fortnightly and monthly payroll.

· Set up and maintain employee payroll records.

· Process ordinary hours, overtime, allowances, bonuses, deductions and reimbursements.

· Process annual leave, personal leave and termination payments.

· Prepare Single Touch Payroll reporting and year-end STP finalisation.

· Calculate and reconcile PAYG withholding.

· Calculate and reconcile employer superannuation.

· Review superannuation clearing house payments and identify rejected or unpaid amounts.

· Reconcile payroll reports, payroll journals and payroll liability accounts.

· Assist with payroll tax, workers compensation and other payroll compliance requirements.



BAS, IAS and Compliance Support



· Prepare BAS and IAS workpapers for internal review.

· Reconcile GST, PAYG withholding and PAYG instalment accounts.

· Review GST reporting under both cash and accrual methods.

· Reconcile BAS figures to the general ledger.

· Identify prior-period errors and transactions requiring GST adjustments.

· Assist with PAYG instalment variation calculations.

· Assist with Taxable Payments Annual Reports.

· Prepare supporting documents and schedules for the firm’s accountants and tax agents.

· Monitor internal deadlines and escalate missing information promptly.



Month-End and Year-End



· Complete monthly, quarterly and annual bookkeeping files.

· Reconcile all material balance sheet accounts.

· Review payroll, GST, superannuation and PAYG liabilities.

· Prepare accruals, prepayments and other adjusting journals.

· Review accounts payable and accounts receivable cut-off.

· Reconcile fixed assets, inventory and cost of goods sold where applicable.

· Prepare year-end workpapers and supporting schedules.

· Ensure client files are ready for financial statement and income tax return preparation.



Financial Reporting



· Prepare Profit and Loss Statements and Balance Sheets.

· Prepare cash flow and management reports where required.

· Compare results with prior periods, budgets or forecasts.

· Identify unusual movements, negative balances and potential accounting errors.

· Provide clear internal explanations and supporting schedules to the Client Manager.



Tax Return Experience – Highly Regarded, but not essential



Experience preparing Australian income tax returns or tax workpapers is not essential but will be a strong advantage.



Relevant experience may include:

· Individual and sole trader tax returns.

· Company tax returns.

· Trust tax returns and distribution workpapers.

· Partnership tax returns.

· Rental property schedules.

· Depreciation and capital allowance schedules.

· Tax reconciliation workpapers.

· Xero Tax, MYOB Practice, HandiTax or BGL.



Essential Experience and Skills



Applicants must have:

· At least five years of recent Australian public practice bookkeeping experience.

· Experience managing bookkeeping for multiple Australian clients.

· Advanced practical experience using Xero.

· Strong practical experience using MYOB.

· Strong practical experience using QuickBooks Online.

· Experience preparing BAS and IAS workpapers.

· Strong knowledge of Australian GST and account coding.

· Demonstrated experience reviewing and correcting GST codes.

· Strong Australian payroll, STP and superannuation experience.

· Advanced reconciliation and problem-solving skills.

· Experience preparing month-end and year-end workpapers.

· Excellent written and spoken English.

· Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.

· The ability to work independently and manage multiple deadlines.

· High standards of confidentiality, integrity and professional conduct.

· Ability to use AI tools



Experience limited to internal bookkeeping for one Australian business may not satisfy the public practice experience requirement.



Qualifications



The following qualifications are highly regarded:

· Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance or Commerce.

· Diploma or recognised qualification in Accounting or Bookkeeping.

· CPA, Chartered Accountant or equivalent studies.

· Xero Advisor Certification.

· MYOB or QuickBooks certification.



Software



You must be confident using:



· Xero

· MYOB

· QuickBooks Online



Independent Contractor Arrangement



This is an independent contractor opportunity and not an employee position.



The contractor will:



· Provide services remotely from the Philippines.

· Provide their own computer, secure workspace, internet and backup power arrangements.

· Be responsible for their own business registration, taxation, invoicing and insurance obligations.

· Issue a valid monthly contractor invoice.



The contractor will ordinarily provide services Monday to Friday and maintain regular overlap with Australian business hours.



The parties will agree on a daily core collaboration window for meetings, questions and internal communication. Outside that window, the contractor may arrange their own working schedule, provided all deadlines and service requirements are met.



Timesheets and Work Records



The contractor must complete a daily timesheet recording:



· Date.

· Client or entity.

· Task performed.

· Time spent.

· Work completed.

· Outstanding issues and next steps.



Timesheets are used for client costing, workflow management, capacity planning and supporting the contractor’s invoice. They are not intended to operate as employee attendance records.

Remote Work Requirements



Applicants must have:



· A reliable computer or laptop.

· Stable high-speed internet.

· Backup internet.

· A quiet and secure home office.

· A suitable headset for online meetings.

· The ability to use multi-factor authentication and secure password systems.

· A strong commitment to privacy, confidentiality and data security.



How to Apply



Please submit:

· Your current resume.

· A brief cover letter of your Australian public practice experience.

· Details of your Xero, MYOB and QuickBooks Online experience.

· Details of your BAS, IAS and Australian payroll experience.

· Details of any Australian tax returns you have prepared.

· Your expected monthly contractor fee in Philippine pesos.

· Your earliest available commencement date.

· Confirmation of your internet.

· Confirmation that you can issue invoices as an independent contractor.



Pay: Php60,000.00 - Php70,000.00 per month

title: DTC VIDEO EDITOR — UGC META ADS USING AI TOOLS
description:
Mon–Fri | $650–$850/month + performance bonuses



I run a small DTC operation with the resources to scale further. We create

mostly AI UGC-style video ads, so I'm looking for someone very comfortable

using AI tools to create high-quality ad creatives fast.



The creatives you make run as paid ads on Meta —
 and Instagram

feeds, reels, and stories.



This is NOT a "make things look cinematic" job. This is a marketing-first

editing role. Every cut, every caption, every transition exists for one

reason: to stop the scroll and drive the click. If a beautiful transition

doesn't help the ad convert, it doesn't go in.



HOW WE OPERATE

We run three stores. One is a US-made product, long-term brand. The other

two are testing stores where we validate new dropshipping products.



This matters for how you'll work. One week I might need a few creatives for

the US brand. The next week the focus shifts entirely to a testing product.

The workload moves with demand. The workflow stays the same. Nothing changes.



To be clear: this is NOT a role where I expect 50 creatives a week for each

store. What I need is someone who can switch between stores without losing

quality and move fast and loose when we're testing something new.



THE STYLE WE MAKE — READ THIS CAREFULLY

Everything we produce is UGC-style: ads that look like a real person filmed

themselves on a phone, not like a brand commercial. That is the entire point.

The moment an ad looks polished or produced, people recognize it as an ad

and scroll past.



In practice that means:

- Talking-head delivery, straight to camera, casual and unscripted-feeling

- Handheld energy, imperfect framing, natural lighting — not studio-clean

- Hard cuts every 2–4 seconds, no fancy transitions, no cinematic color grades

- Big readable captions burned in, because most people watch with sound off

- B-roll cut in to show the product doing the thing being talked about

- The first 2 seconds must stop the scroll or nothing else matters



The hard part with AI: making an AI avatar and AI voiceover feel like a real

person instead of a corporate presenter. If your HeyGen output looks like a

news anchor, it will not convert. Prompting and editing your way to something

that feels human is the core skill I'm hiring for.



MUST KNOW HOW TO PROMPT AND USE:

Higgsfield (Image / Video generations — mostly B-ROLL)

HeyGen (Avatar / Video generations) -> Mostly Talking Heads

ElevenLabs (Voice overs)

ChatGPT / Claude (For prompting)

Notion (our business operates in Notion) (Simple use)

Google Drive (where we organize and save videos/assets)

CapCut and/or Adobe Premiere Pro



YOU SHOULD UNDERSTAND:

AI avatars

AI voiceovers

Prompting for realistic outputs

UGC-style ad structure

Hooks, pacing, captions, b-roll

Meta ad creative testing

Fast creative variations

Working within a defined brand style when the project calls for it



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:

We will give you the script and a reference video, competitor ad, or idea,

and you'll turn it into an AI UGC-style video ad ready to test on

and Instagram.



You should be able to move fast, follow instructions, and improve creative

quality over time.



REQUIREMENTS:

Must speak English fluently

Must have a portfolio

Must be comfortable with AI tools and willing to learn new ones as they appear

Must be organized and able to work inside Notion

Must be available Monday to Friday. No weekend work expected.

Must be able to adapt between different products, brands, and styles

Must understand that this is a performance creative role, not just a

design/editing role



WHAT YOU GET:

$650–$850/month depending on experience and speed

Performance bonuses on ads that win and scale

Long-term role with room to grow.



HOW TO APPLY — IMPORTANT (otherwise I won't even open your application)

Start your application with the letter "X" in your TITLE, not the

application text.



Then include:

1. Your portfolio (Just a Google Drive link is enough. I don't care about

   "beautiful" presentations.) If you have UGC-style, direct response, or

   Meta/Instagram ads in there, put those first — that's what I'm looking at.

2. Years of experience and where you worked. (A project, a business, solo

   projects, hobbies around video editing)

3. Which tools you have used: Higgsfield, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, ChatGPT,

   Claude, Notion, Google Drive

4. Your expected monthly salary in USD within the $650–$850 range —

   if more than that, explain why

5. How many videos you can realistically create per week (IMPORTANT)



IMPORTANT: Applications that do not start with X will not be reviewed.



SAMPLE EDIT

If you qualify after I review your portfolio, I'll reach out and ask you to

hop on a video call. Then I'll ask you to do a sample edit of around 30

seconds (no tools or payment included for the sample edit) — a UGC-style ad from a script I'll give you — to see your

skills in action. If I like what I see, you're hired!

title: eCommerce Marketplace Operations Specialist - Shopify & eBay
description:
We are a U.S.-based eCommerce business seeking an experienced VA Marketplace Operations Specialist to research products, create eBay listings, and manage our Shopify catalog and customer communications.



The primary focus is to produce accurate, well-researched product listings. You will also use our cross-listing system, LitCommerce, to connect Shopify and eBay, perform inventory checks, and manage customer inquiries from our Shopify store.



Product Listing Responsibilities



* Research unfamiliar products using active and sold comparable listings.

* Determine appropriate pricing based on market data and condition.

* Create accurate product records in Shopify.

* Use our cross-listing system to prepare corresponding eBay drafts.

* Complete eBay titles, descriptions, categories, item specifics, condition notes, pricing, and policies.

* Organize Shopify products and collections.

* Edit product photographs using Canva or PhotoRoom.

* Review listings carefully before submitting them for approval.



Catalog and Inventory Management



* Check that SKUs, variants, prices, and quantities match across platforms.

* Identify duplicate, missing, unlinked, or incorrectly connected products.

* Perform regular Shopify and eBay catalog audits.

* Investigate synchronization and inventory discrepancies.

* Maintain a tracker of completed listings and discovered problems.

* Document issues before making corrections

* Ask for approval before deleting products, ending listings, changing synchronization settings, or performing bulk updates.



Shopify Customer Support



* Monitor Shopify Inbox and store-related
s.

* Answer basic product, availability, and order-status questions using our guidelines.

* Record customer requests and maintain clear notes.

* Notify us promptly when an urgent response or review is needed.



Reporting and Communication



* Send a concise update at the end of each working day.

* List completed products and tasks.

* Report discrepancies, customer issues, and blockers

* Maintain a “Needs Review” list for listings or decisions awaiting approval.

* Flag urgent matters immediately rather than waiting for the daily update.

* Provide a weekly summary of catalog accuracy and outstanding work.



Required Experience



* Minimum 2 years of Shopify product and inventory-management experience

* At least 2 years of working knowledge of eBay Seller Hub and eBay listing requirements

* Proven experience using cross-listing or multichannel inventory software (2+ years preferred)

* Professional written and spoken English

, chat, text, or phone

title: Meta & Google Ads Buyer — European Denim eCommerce | $1,560/mo | CET Hours
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



We're hiring a hands-on Meta and Google Ads buyer for the European arm of an Australian denim and fashion group. You'll own day-to-day paid media across Sweden, Norway and the Netherlands, and you'll be the person who connects ad spend to what's actually happening in the Shopify store — revenue, stock, promotions and margin.



The company is bringing paid media in-house from an external agency. You are the internal team. That means you build and optimise the campaigns yourself; you are not briefing an agency and summarising their reports.



Creative is supplied by the marketing team. Your job is campaign management, testing, optimisation, tracking and commercial results.



This is a long-term, full-time contract role through Adminworks, an Australian staffing company. You'd be joining a team of 40+ Filipino contractors placed into Australian and European fashion and retail businesses. Paid weekly, in USD, on time, every week.





WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO



- Build, launch and optimise campaigns in Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads across three European markets

- Pace daily spend against approved budgets and shift it based on performance, stock availability and promotions

- Run structured tests — audiences, bidding, offers, campaign structures, product sets, creative variants, landing pages

- Keep conversion tracking reliable across Meta, Google and Shopify

- Maintain a daily e-commerce performance tracker (revenue, ROAS, MER, CAC/CPA, conversion rate, AOV, spend vs target)

- Post a short daily update: results, risks, decisions, what you're doing next

- Join a daily huddle and a weekly Thursday meeting during European hours





WHAT WE NEED



- 3+ years running paid media for an e-commerce or DTC brand — hands on, in the account, with budget responsibility

- Strong Meta Ads Manager. Working Google Ads (Search + Shopping/PMax)

- You've owned campaigns, not coordinated an agency

- Comfortable in Shopify and confident in spreadsheets

- Understand GA4, GTM, Meta Pixel, Conversions API, UTMs and attribution well enough to spot when tracking is broken

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Genuinely available for the European hours below, every day





NICE TO HAVE (not required — tell us if you have it)



- Fashion, apparel or footwear brands

- European or Nordic markets

- Google Shopping, Performance Max, Merchant Center

- Meta catalogue / dynamic product ads

- Klaviyo or lifecycle marketing

- Experience taking paid media in-house from an agency





HOURS



This role runs on European time: Monday to Friday, 9:00am-5:00pm CET/CEST. In the Philippines that is roughly 3:00pm to 11:00pm, shifting to 4:00pm to midnight over the European summer. It takes your evenings. If that doesn't work for your life right now, please don't apply — we'd rather you told us today than three weeks in.





WHAT YOU GET



- $1,560 USD per month, paid weekly

- Long-term contract with a real company, not a one-off gig

- Paid Philippine public holidays and paid leave

- Direct access to the European GM and the eCommerce manager — you'll be in the room where the trading decisions get made

- A named brand portfolio you can point to for the rest of your career





HOW TO APPLY



Please put the word DENIM at the top of your message so we know you read this.



Then answer these three questions. Short answers are fine — we're reading for specifics, not length.



1. Name one e-commerce account you personally ran. Tell us the brand or category, the market, the monthly spend, and the ROAS or CPA you were working to.



2. What did YOU change on that account that moved the number? Be specific about the decision, not the outcome.



3. Rate yourself 1-5, honestly: Meta Ads / Google Ads / Shopping & PMax / Shopify / GA4 / GTM / Pixel & CAPI / Spreadsheets. We'd rather see a truthful 2 than an optimistic 5.



Attach your CV. If you have redacted Ads Manager or Google Ads screenshots, send them — they'll move you to the front of the queue.



Optional but it helps: record a 2-minute Loom walking us through one campaign you're proud of. Nothing polished, just you and a screen share.



We reply to every applicant who follows these instructions. We're looking for the successful candidate to start within 21 days.

title: Asterisk / FreePBX Engineer — Production PBX (Full-Time)
description:
Start your application with the word TRUNK so I know you read this post.



I run two production Asterisk/FreePBX servers handling live inbound calls for

US businesses. Several thousand DIDs across both. This is real traffic - when

the PBX is down, revenue stops.



I have already completed a full technical audit of both systems. The findings

are written up as issues in a private GitHub repo. I need one person to work

those issues: pick them up, diagnose, fix, test, push, and document what

changed.



This role is telephony only. You will not touch my websites, CRM, or other

applications. Your entire focus is the two PBX servers and the backend code

around them.



WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING



- Working through an existing backlog of audited issues on the PBX systems

- Inbound call routing: DIDs, inbound routes, IVRs, queues, time conditions,

  failover destinations

- Custom dialplan work where the FreePBX GUI cannot express the logic

- SIP trunk configuration and carrier troubleshooting

- Debugging call failures end to end - carrier SIP trace, Asterisk logs,

  AstDB, dialplan, database state, backend workers

- Backend Node.js services that interact with the PBX

- Blocking, rate limiting, and spam-protection logic

- CDR reporting and call-data queries

- Documenting every change and the reason for it



TECHNICAL ENVIRONMENT



- Asterisk / FreePBX on Ubuntu

- chan_pjsip, SIP trunks (registration-based and IP-authenticated)

- Custom dialplan in extensions_custom.conf, AGI hand-offs

- Node.js backend services, PM2, Nginx

title: Asterisk / FreePBX Engineer + Voice AI Integration (Full-Time)
description:

I run two production Asterisk/FreePBX servers handling live inbound calls for US businesses. Several thousand DIDs across both. This is real traffic - when the PBX is down, revenue stops.



There are two halves to this job.



FIRST: fix what's broken. I have already completed a full technical audit of both systems. The findings are written up as issues in a private GitHub repo. You pick them up, diagnose, fix, test, push, and document what changed.



SECOND: build the after-hours voice AI. I want an AI agent answering calls on nights and weekends - capturing the caller's details, handling common requests, and escalating or taking a message when it can't. You'll design and build that integration into the existing PBX.



This role is telephony only. You will not touch my websites, CRM, or other applications. Your entire focus is the two PBX servers, the voice AI layer, and the backend code around them.

- Working through an existing backlog of audited issues

- Custom dialplan work where the FreePBX GUI cannot express the logic

- SIP trunk configuration and carrier troubleshooting

- Debugging call failures end to end - carrier SIP trace, Asterisk logs, AstDB, dialplan, database state, backend workers

- Blocking, rate limiting, and spam-protection logic

- CDR reporting and call-data queries

- Handling interruption and barge-in so the caller can speak over the agent

- Warm transfer and escalation: the agent hands off to a human, a queue, or voi
 when it can't handle the call

- A fallback path so that if the AI service is slow or down, the call still gets answered. Callers must never hit dead air.

- Capturing what happened on the call - transcript, caller details, outcome - and pushing it somewhere useful

- Tuning the agent based on real call recordings, not assumptions



TECHNICAL ENVIRONMENT



- Asterisk / FreePBX on Ubuntu

- chan_pjsip, SIP trunks (registration-based and IP-authenticated)

- Custom dialplan in extensions_custom.conf, AGI hand-offs

- Node.js well enough to read, fix, and build backend services around the PBX

- Git workflow: branch, commit with a clear message, pull request

- You trace a problem to root cause before changing anything, and you can say which segment of the call path owns the fault

- Strong written English - every fix needs a written explanation



STRONG PLUS



- You have already connected an AI voice agent to a real phone system - Vapi, Retell, ElevenLabs, Deepgram, OpenAI Realtime, or a custom STT/LLM/TTS pipeline

- Real-time media streaming from Asterisk (AudioSocket, ARI externalMedia, EAGI)

NOT A FIT IF



- Your VoIP experience is only Twilio, Vapi, or Retell rather than running a PBX yourself

- You have only used the FreePBX web interface and never edited a config file or read an Asterisk log

- You need task-by-task supervision

- You would test a change on a production system carrying live calls



PROCESS



Short call, then a PAID technical assessment on an isolated staging PBX (4-6 hours, paid at your rate). Long-term full-time position. References checked before any production access is granted. You will need 3-4 hours of daily overlap with US Central time.



TO APPLY - ANSWER THESE SIX QUESTIONS



Applications without answers will not be reviewed. Attach your resume and any GitHub or work I can look at - but an application with a resume and no answers will be ignored. Short and specific beats long and general.



Q1. Describe one real call-path problem you traced end to end. Where exactly did the call die, how did you prove it, and what did you change?

???????????????????????????????????????

???????????????????????????????????????

YOUR DAILY WORKFLOW

???????????????????????????????????????

You receive image prompts from us. You generate the start frames for

You combine the animated character clip with the German ElevenLabs 

voice using Higgsfield's lip-sync feature. You verify the lip 

movements match the German audio and iterate if needed.



Step 5 — Final assembly (CapCut)

You edit everything together in CapCut:

- Lip-synced character animations + voice

- Captions in our brand style (we provide the style guide)

title: Video Editor for Performance Ads Meta
description:
ABOUT US

We are a German Direct-to-Consumer supplement brand in the women's 

health space. Our entire creative workflow is AI-powered — from image 

generation to voice-overs to video clips. We produce high-performing 

direct-response ads for Meta and TikTok, targeting German-speaking 

women aged 35-55. (Brand name shared with shortlisted candidates.)



THE OPPORTUNITY

We are starting this role as PART TIME (around 20-30 hours per week). 

If you perform well during the first 4-8 weeks, we will upgrade you to 

FULL TIME with a higher monthly retainer. We are looking for a 

long-term editor, not a one-off freelancer. Our top performer can 

become our lead video editor and grow with the brand.



WHAT YOU WILL EDIT

60 to 180 second talking-head ads in UGC and authority style. Each ad 

combines:

- AI-generated video clips (Kling 3.0, Veo 3.1)

- AI-generated still images (NanoBanana Pro) that you will animate

- ElevenLabs voice-overs (in German — you do NOT need to speak German)

- Medical 3D visualizations

- Occasional real stock footage

All edited together in CapCut Pro.



REQUIRED HARD SKILLS

- Advanced CapCut Pro: keyframe animations, slide-in/pop-up overlays, 

  multi-track editing with 5+ tracks simultaneously (talking head, 

  B-roll, visuals, text overlays, audio, music)

- Voice-over-driven cutting: every cut must land precisely on the 

  spoken word. The voice-over sets the rhythm, NOT the music. This 

  is critical.

- Subtitle creation and styling: bold, colored, animated, with key 

  words highlighted in a different color. Subtitles must never cover 

  the face or important visuals.

- Text overlays for hooks, benefit callouts, and CTAs — cleanly 

  animated in and out, on-brand

- Infographic card overlays flown in over talking-head clips (e.g., a 

  card showing what each herb does, or a comparison table)

- Color correction and color grading to make AI-generated clips 

  visually consistent. AI clips often have slightly different color 

  temperature, saturation, and exposure — you must match them so the 

  final video looks like it came from one source.

- Audio mixing: voice-over loud and clear in the foreground, 

  background music subtle (15-20% of voice-over volume), clean 

  crossfades, no hard audio cuts

- Export in 9:16 (1080x1920) for Meta/TikTok, plus 1:1 versions when 

  requested



REQUIRED UNDERSTANDING

- Direct-response ad structure: Hook, Problem, Agitation, Mechanism, 

  Product Reveal, Social Proof, CTA. You don't need to write this — 

  but when editing you must FEEL where each section starts and ends 

  and match the visual rhythm to it.

- Pacing and cut rhythm: the hook (first 3 seconds) needs fast cuts 

  and visual surprise. The mechanism explanation needs slower cuts 

  so information lands. The CTA needs calm and clarity. You must 

  master this fast/slow alternation.

- Talking head ? B-roll switching every 3-8 seconds. Talking head 

  builds trust, B-roll proves or visualizes what is being said.

- Handling AI-generated clips: clips sometimes have artifacts, weird 

  first/last frames, imperfect lip-sync, unnatural hand movements. 

  You must know how to hide these issues — trim first/last frames, 

  use cutaways to B-roll at the right 
nt, light cropping/

  repositioning, smart transitions.

- Scroll-stopping hooks: the first 3 seconds d
 whether someone 

  keeps watching or scrolls away. You must be able to cut multiple 

  hook variations of the same ad for A/B testing.

- Audience awareness: our target is women 35-55, NOT Gen-Z TikTok 

  users. The aesthetic is warm, trustworthy, mature — NOT loud, 

  flashy, or Gen-Z. This is critical and most editors get it wrong.



NICE TO HAVE

- After Effects or DaVinci Resolve experience for animated 

  infographics, particle effects, kinetic typography

- Experience with Meta Ads Creative — knowledge of Hook Rate, Hold 

  Rate, Thumb-Stop Ratio

- Split-testing experience (different hooks, CTAs, visual styles)

- Experience editing health, wellness, or supplement-style ads with 

  a professional but not clinical look



WHAT YOU WILL RECEIVE FROM US

- Numbered clips (Clip 1 to Clip 46 etc.)

- Full ad copy as a text document

- Timing per clip with clear labels (talking head vs visual/B-roll)

- Final voice-over as audio file

- Mood references / example videos

- Brand colors, fonts, and logo files



WHAT YOU DELIVER

The fully edited video with subtitles, text overlays, music, and 

infographic overlays — export-ready in 9:16 (and 1:1 when requested).



WORK VOLUME & EXPECTATIONS

- Multiple new ads per week

- Fast turnarounds — first rough cut within 24-48 hours

- Heavy iteration — you will often be asked to cut 3 different hooks 

  for the same ad, change a CTA, or swap a scene. This is NOT 

  criticism, this is performance marketing. Editors who take 

  iteration personally will not work here.

- Creative freedom within structure: copy and clip order are fixed, 

  but transitions, zoom levels, text animations, and music choice 

  are yours.



GROWTH PATH

- Weeks 1-2: Paid trial period (1-2 ads to evaluate fit)

- Weeks 3-8: Part-time collaboration, building rhythm together

- Month 2+: If output and quality are strong, upgrade to full-time 

  position with higher monthly pay and lead editor responsibilities



LANGUAGE NOTE

The ads are in German, but you do NOT need to speak German. Subtitles 

will be reviewed by a German native speaker on our team. You only 

need to copy-paste subtitles correctly from the script we provide.



HOW TO APPLY

Please send:

1. Portfolio link (Google Drive, Vimeo, or website) — ideally with 

   at least 2 examples of direct-response or UGC-style ads you have 

   edited

2. Short answer (3-5 sentences) on this question: "When you receive 

   an AI-generated talking head clip with a weird first frame and 

   slightly off lip-sync, how do you handle it?"

3. Your CapCut Pro experience (months/years) and whether you also 

   use After Effects or DaVinci

4. Your available hours per week and time zone

5. Your rate (per hour OR per finished ad — your choice)



Applications without a portfolio will not be reviewed.

title: Property Bookeeper & Administrator
description:
Position Title: Property Bookkeeper & Administrator

Location: [Your Location / Remote / Hybrid]

Employment Type: [Full-Time / Part-Time / Contract]

Reporting To: Business Owner / Operations Director

About the Role

We are an expanding property management and development business managing a portfolio of ~15 Houses in Multiple Occupation (HMOs) comprising roughly 90 individual rooms, alongside property maintenance and refurbishment projects.

We are bringing our property management in-house while onboarding third-party client properties. We are seeking an experienced, detail-oriented Property Bookkeeper & Administrator to take full ownership of our day-to-day financial operations. This role bridges general property accounting (rent reconciliations, landlord statements) and Construction Industry Scheme (CIS) compliance for our subcontractor workforce.

Key Responsibilities

1. HMO Property & Client Accounting

● Rent Tracking & Reconciliation: Monitor incoming rent payments for ~90 tenant rooms across multiple properties, matching payments promptly and resolving arrears.

● Client Landlord Statements: Generate accurate, timely monthly payout statements and invoices for third-party property owners, deducting management fees and maintenance costs.

● Tenant & Landlord Invoicing: Draft and dispatch monthly management fee invoices, tenant utility recharges, and deposit receipts.

2. CIS (Construction Industry Scheme) & Subcontractors

● Invoice Auditing: Review all subcontractor invoices to ensure clear, accurate split between Labour and Materials in line with HMRC guidelines.

● Deductions & Returns: Calculate CIS on labour, issue monthly CIS Payment Statements (vouchers) to subcontractors, and submit monthly HMRC CIS returns accurately and on time.

3. Core Bookkeeping & Financial Control

● Bank Reconciliation: Perform daily/weekly bank reconciliations across all business accounts.

● Purchase Ledger & Receipts: Process supplier invoices, receipts, and operational expenses, categorising them correctly by property/job for accurate cost tracking.

● Credit Control & Arrears Management: Keep tenant and client accounts up to date, actively chasing overdue rents or outstanding invoices.

title: Instagram DM Sales Rep (Sell by Chat) - Own the Whole Process
description:
JOB TITLE

Instagram DM Sales Closer (3+ Years) - Own Our Entire DM Sales Channel



TYPE OF WORK

Part time to start (15 hrs/week), moving to full time



SALARY

PHP 450 to 600 per hour depending on what you can prove, plus PHP 2,000 commission for every new member you sign, uncapped



HOURS

5 days a week inside 9:00am to 5:00pm Manila time (times are negotiable)





=====================================



READ THIS PART FIRST



This is not a message answering job and it is not a virtual assistant job. We are handing one person our entire Instagram sales channel and asking them to run it.



You will report to the founder, but will have complete ownership of the sales system. If you need to be told what to do each day, this role will not work for you and you should not apply.



We want someone who has done this for at least three years, who has their own opinions about what works, and who has proven results.





ABOUT US



We are a sports nutrition coaching business based in Sydney, Australia. We work with fighters. MMA, boxing, BJJ, judo, wrestling. Our job is to get them to their fight weight without wrecking their performance on fight night.



We run Instagram content and paid ads and we get a steady flow of new leads every week. Right now the founder handles those conversations between coaching calls, which means good leads go cold and most never get followed up.





HOW THE ROLE GROWS



You start part time on inbound only. Roughly the first 4 to 8 weeks, 15 hours a week. You learn our voice, our offer and our fighters, and you work only the leads who come to us: our free making weight calculator, our free ebook, ad leads in Leads Center, story replies and comment to DM. We start you here because we want you closing well before we scale your volume.



Once your numbers hold for two straight weeks, you move to full time and add outbound. That means 40 hours a week, keeping all the inbound, and going out to find fighters who already have a competition booked instead of waiting for them to find us. Hashtags, event pages, fight cards, gym accounts, our past clients, our old lead list and our workshop buyers.



Outbound is where this role gets interesting, because it is the half you get to design. We will tell you what our best clients look like. How you go and find more of them is your call.



The move to full time is based on your numbers, not on time served. We expect it to happen. If it does not, we hired the wrong person.





WHAT YOU OWN



Everything between a stranger seeing our content and a fighter paying us.



- Opening conversations, personalised to the human on the other end, never copy paste

- Qualifying properly, and letting go of the ones we cannot help quickly and politely

- Presenting the offer, handling objections, closing the sale

- Following up on a set cadence, not whenever you remember

- Reactivating our past clients and old leads

- Building and running the outbound side once you are full time

- Logging every conversation in the CRM with stage and outcome

- Owning the numbers, reporting them weekly, and telling us what the objections are saying about our offer and our ads



You will be given a proven script, an offer document, an objection bank and a library of real conversations that have already turned into sales. You are not starting from zero. But we expect you to improve on all of it. If our script is losing people at a certain point, we want you to tell us and rewrite it, not run it silently for six months.





WHAT YOU ARE NOT



You are not the coach. You will never give nutrition advice, weight cutting advice, training advice or anything medical. If someone asks a coaching question you get them excited about speaking to the coach and pass it up.



Any message about a weight cut in progress, an injury or anything clinical gets escalated to the founder straight away. We are a health business and this rule is not negotiable.





THE NUMBERS YOU WILL BE HELD TO



You see your own scoreboard and so do we. We review it every week.



While you are on inbound:

- First reply to a new lead: within 15 minutes during your shift

- New leads left untouched at end of shift: zero

- Opener to reply rate: 30% or better

- Reply to qualified conversation: 25% or better

- Qualified to offer presented: 60% or better

- Offer presented to sale: 25% or better

- Follow up compliance: 100% of open threads touched on cadence

- Minimum 10 sign ups per month (20k commission bonus per month)

- Conversations logged in CRM: 100%



Once you add outbound:

- New outbound conversations opened per day: 30 to 50

- Outbound targets who already have a competition booked: 70% or better



Inbound and outbound are tracked separately. They convert very differently and we do not want them blended.



For your first 30 days we hold you to the process and the volume, not the sales. After that, conversion is the job.





YOU WILL BE GREAT AT THIS IF



- You have 3+ years selling by chat and can show us the receipts, not just describe them

- You have owned a sales channel before, not just executed someone else's steps

- You are comfortable being ignored seven times out of ten and still showing up the next day

- You write like a real person. Short messages, real questions, no essays, no corporate tone, no obvious templates

- You already track your own numbers because you want to beat them

- You bring solutions. When something is broken you arrive with two options and a recommendation

- You can be trusted with our Instagram account and our brand voice without supervision





YOU WILL HATE THIS ROLE IF



- You want a manager checking in on you three times a day

- You want a fixed script you never have to think about

- You are uncomfortable telling the founder he is wrong about something

- You have only ever done customer support or admin work in an inbox





TOOLS



Meta Business Suite and Leads Center, ManyChat, Google Sheets. You must have used Business Suite and Leads Center before. 





WHAT WE OFFER



- PHP 450 to 600 per hour based on what you can show us you have done

- PHP 2,000 for every new member you sign, uncapped, from day one

- A 30 day ramp where we pay commission at target while you learn, so you are not out of pocket during training

- A clear, numbers based path from 20 hours to 40 hours, and we want you to get there fast

- A yearly budget for a sales course of your choosing

- Long term work with one client, direct access to the founder, and no layers in between

- Real room to grow. As this scales, the person in this seat runs the sales side and hires the next rep





HOW TO APPLY



Read this carefully. We reject anyone who misses a step, because following instructions is the first test of the job.



Start your message with the word CORNERMAN so we know you read the whole post.



Then send us:



1. A voice note, 60 to 90 seconds. Tell us why you would be good at this, and walk us through one sale you made entirely by chat, start to finish.



2. Two screenshots of real DM conversations you ran end to end. Cover the names. We want to see how you actually write.



3. Your numbers. Conversations per day, reply rate, close rate, and how you tracked them. If you do not have real numbers, say so honestly rather than inventing them.



4. A three message opener for this lead: a 24 year old amateur MMA fighter followed us after watching a reel and downloaded our free making weight calculator. He has not replied to anything yet. Write the exact first three messages you would send him.



5. One thing you would want to change or test in a DM funnel like ours in your first month, and why. Two or three sentences is plenty. This is the question we care most about.



6. Your available start date.



We want to move fast. Shortlisted applicants get a paid test project and then an interview with the founder. We want someone in the seat within two weeks.

title: AI Appointment Setting Specialist — Instagram DM Bot and Automation

Prompt engineering: write, test, and iterate on AI setter prompts that mirror a skilled human setter — building rapport, handling objections, qualifying leads, and locking in booked calls

You have hands-on n8n experience and can build or fix automations yourself without being guided



You can work with Claude, Relevance.ai, or similar LLM tools — not just prompt templates

Do not send me a generic chat gpt response, i have hired over 50 people from online jobs and you will not be accepted if you do not put effort into your application.



If you have only built chatbots for customer support or FAQ responses and have never built one with the goal of booking sales calls or generating revenue, this role is not for you.

title: Senior QA & Usability Lead – Pre-Launch Website + App Audit
description:
About the Role



We're preparing to launch an online product / app — and want an experienced tester to run a thorough pre-launch audit, not a first-pass checklist. We're looking for someone with a real track record: 5+ years of hands-on QA/usability work, comfortable owning the whole testing process with minimal oversight, and able to flag the kind of issues a junior tester wouldn't catch (confusing flows, edge cases, things that would embarrass us in front of a customer).



This is a two-part engagement: a technical QA audit and a usability testing pass, both delivered by the same senior person (or a small team you lead).



Part 1: Technical QA Audit

Full functional pass across the website and app: every link, form, button, and flow — cross-browser (Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge) and cross-device (desktop, mobile, tablet)

Regression-test critical paths: signup/login, checkout/payment (if applicable), core app workflows

Log every defect with severity, reproduction steps, screenshots/recordings, and environment details in a tracker (Jira, Trello, or your preferred tool)

Flag structural or business-logic issues, not just surface bugs — the "this technically works but will confuse or cost us customers" category

Part 2: Usability Testing & Review

Design and run a usability test using an established tool (Lyssna, Maze, UserTesting, or your own preferred platform)

Recruit or source participants who reasonably match our target customer — we want real signal, not internal opinions

Deliver a clear findings report: where people hesitated or got confused, what they misread, first-click/task-completion data, and concrete, prioritized recommendations



What We're Looking For



5+ years of professional QA and/or usability testing experience, ideally on SaaS, eCommerce, or web app products

A track record you can point to — platforms tested, scale of projects, or client outcomes

Direct experience with at least one usability testing platform (Lyssna/UsabilityHub, Maze, UserTesting, or similar)

Strong written English — your reports need to stand on their own without a lot of back-and-forth

Able to work independently, prioritize issues by real business impact (not just raw bug count), and push back if something looks wrong







Please include:



A brief summary of your QA/usability background — years of experience, platforms/industries you've worked in

Specific usability testing tools you've used



A short example of a past finding or bug report you're proud of (redacted if confidential)

Your rate and availability

Work Arrangement: Fully Remote

Preferred Location: Southeast Asia

Time Zone: Hong Kong Time (UTC+8)

Schedule: Flexible, aside from pre-scheduled meetings



About the Role

We are seeking a detail-oriented and highly organized Virtual Executive Assistant to support a Hong Kong-based interior designer and furniture supplier.



This role goes beyond traditional administrative support. You will act as a reliable right-hand person, helping manage spreadsheets, project documentation, files, meetings, travel arrangements, and day-to-day operations. Your support will allow the business owner to focus on creative work, clients, and business development.



The ideal candidate is proactive, dependable, and comfortable working independently. You should be able to take ownership of tasks, follow through without constant supervision, and identify what needs to be done before being asked.



Key Responsibilities

Excel and Finance Administration

Update and maintain spreadsheets for budgets, invoices, expenses, vendor payments, and other financial records.

Ensure information is accurate, properly formatted, and kept up to date.

Follow up on missing information or documentation when needed.

Specifications and Project Documentation

Draft, update, and format product specifications and project schedules using provided templates and examples.

Work with documentation covering material finishes, furniture, sanitaryware, hardware, lighting, artwork, and other interior architecture-related items.

Review documents for accuracy, consistency, formatting, and written English.

Maintain proper file naming, organization, and version control across Google Drive and Dropbox.

Meeting and Administrative Support

Attend selected client and team meetings when required.

Prepare clear, action-oriented meeting minutes and track follow-up items.

Assist with calendar coordination and help prevent scheduling conflicts.

Monitor deadlines, outstanding tasks, and required follow-ups.

Handle general administrative and operational tasks as needed.

Travel Coordination

Occasionally assist with business or personal travel arrangements.

Research and book flights, accommodation, and transportation.

Prepare clear and practical travel itineraries.



What We Are Looking For

Advanced Excel Skills: You can create, update, organize, and format spreadsheets accurately and efficiently.

Strong Attention to Detail: You notice errors, inconsistencies, and missing information before they become problems.

Proactive and Resourceful: You take initiative, follow through, and actively seek the information needed to complete your work.

Highly Organized: You have reliable systems for managing documents, files, deadlines, and priorities.

Dependable and Responsive: You communicate promptly and provide updates without needing to be chased.

Process-Minded: You enjoy improving workflows, creating order, and identifying more efficient ways of working.

Independent: You are comfortable working remotely, managing your time, and completing tasks with minimal supervision.

Strong Written English: You can prepare clear, polished, and professional documents and correspondence.



Qualifications

Diploma or bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Accounting, Interior Design, Architecture, or a related field.

At least 2–3 years of relevant experience in executive assistance, administration, operations, accounting support, or project coordination.

Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and the Microsoft Office Suite.

Experience using Google Drive, Dropbox, or similar document management platforms.

Experience in interior design, architecture, furniture supply, construction, or another fast-paced creative industry is preferred but not required.

Professional working proficiency in spoken and written English.

Mandarin language skills are an advantage but not required.



What We Offer

Flexible Schedule: Complete your work around your preferred schedule, provided deadlines are met and you are available for pre-scheduled meetings.

Part-Time Hours: Approximately 8–12 hours per week.

Fully Remote Work: Work from home from anywhere in Southeast Asia.

Minimal Meetings: One 30-minute weekly catch-up, plus occasional project or client meetings when required.

Independent Working Environment: No micromanagement. You will be trusted to manage your responsibilities and deliver results.

International Exposure: Work with clients, suppliers, and vendors across Hong Kong, China, Southeast Asia, Australia, New Zealand, and the United States.

Probationary Period: A one-month probationary period to ensure the arrangement is a good fit for both parties.

Competitive Compensation: Salary will be based on your skills, experience, and availability.

**Salary: ₱30,000 PHP/month**

**Hours: 40 hours per week**

**Remote | Long-Term Role**



We are an established e-commerce company looking for a reliable, highly organized **full-time Creator Partnerships & Operations Assistant** to join our team.



This is not a highly specialized role.



Your main responsibility will be managing communication with our content creators and making sure nothing gets missed. Outside of this, you will help with a variety of operational, research and administrative tasks using tools such as ChatGPT, Notion, Google Sheets and other AI software.



We are looking for someone who is proactive, responsive and capable of figuring things out without needing constant supervision.



## Your Main Responsibilities



### Creator Communication & Management



You will take ownership of our creator communication.



This includes:



* Replying to creators quickly and professionally

* Following up with creators who have not responded

* Onboarding new creators

* Sending creative briefs and instructions

* Following up on outstanding videos/content

* Keeping our creator tracker completely up to date

* Organizing submitted content

* Saving and categorizing videos and raw footage

* Making sure deadlines are followed

* Identifying strong creators we should work with again

* Flagging any problems that require management attention



We do not want management having to remember which creator needs to be followed up with.



**You will own this process.**



## AI, Research & General Operations



When creator communication is under control, you will assist the team with ad hoc tasks such as:



* Using ChatGPT and other AI tools for research

* Competitor research

* Organizing information

* Creating and updating SOPs

* Turning Loom videos or instructions into written processes

* Updating Notion

* Updating spreadsheets and trackers

* Collecting and organizing data

* Researching brands, creators, products or competitors

* Drafting outreach messages

* Uploading and organizing files

* Helping complete miscellaneous operational tasks

* Supporting other members of the team when required



The exact tasks will change from week to week, so you need to be comfortable learning new things.



## What We Are Looking For



You should be:



* Highly organized

* Reliable

* Fast at replying to messages

* Comfortable following up and chasing people

* Fluent in written English

* Detail-oriented

* Comfortable using AI tools such as ChatGPT

* Comfortable using Google Sheets

* Comfortable learning new software

* Able to follow instructions carefully

* Able to work independently

* Proactive when you see something that needs to be done

* Comfortable asking questions when genuinely necessary

* Able to solve simple problems yourself rather than waiting for instructions



Previous experience with creators, influencer marketing, e-commerce or Amazon is useful but **not required**.



We care more about your attitude, organization and ability to learn.



## What Success Looks Like



After joining the team:



* Creator messages are answered within one working day

* No creator is forgotten

* Overdue creators are consistently followed up

* Every active creator is correctly recorded in our tracker

* Submitted content is organized properly

* Management can immediately see the status of every creator

* Operational tasks are completed accurately and on time
