title: Amazon/Walmart VA – Full Account Management
description:
We're looking for a detail-oriented, proactive Virtual Assistant to fully manage our day-to-day Seller Central operations — from daily account maintenance and customer service to PPC advertising, product image creation, listing optimization, and everything in between. This is a full-scope role for someone who can own the account end to end with minimal supervision.



What You'll Do



PPC & Advertising



Create, launch, and manage Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display campaigns on Amazon

Manage Walmart Connect (Sponsored Products) campaigns

Conduct daily/weekly bid adjustments, budget management, and search term (negative keyword) mining

Monitor ACOS/TACOS, ROAS, CTR, and conversion rates; provide weekly performance reports

Run keyword research for new campaign targets and expansion opportunities



Product Images & Creative



Design and edit product listing images (main image, infographics, lifestyle images, comparison charts) in accordance with Amazon and Walmart image guidelines

Create A+ Content / Enhanced Brand Content modules and Walmart Enhanced Content

Design storefront/brand store graphics and banners as needed

Work from provided product photos, brand guidelines, and reference listings to produce on-brand creative

Basic photo editing/retouching (background removal, resizing, compression for upload requirements)



Daily Account Maintenance



Monitor Amazon and Walmart Seller Central dashboards daily for account health, policy violations, and performance notifications

Respond to buyer/customer messages within required response-time windows

Track and manage orders, shipments, returns, and refunds

Monitor inventory levels and flag low-stock/restock needs

Check and resolve listing errors, suppressed listings, and pricing/Buy Box issues

Track account health metrics (ODR, late shipment rate, valid tracking rate, etc.) and escalate issues promptly

Respond to and manage product reviews/feedback where applicable

Maintain a daily/weekly task log or checklist for the team



Listing Optimization & Keyword Research



Conduct keyword research using tools such as Helium 10, Jungle Scout, or similar

Write and optimize listing titles, bullet points, descriptions, and backend search terms for both Amazon and Walmart

Monitor listing health, suppress/error flags, and buy box status

Perform competitor research and identify optimization opportunities

Assist with keyword indexing checks and rank tracking



Catalog & Listing Management



Create new product listings on Amazon and Walmart (single and variation/parent-child listings)

Prepare and upload flat files/bulk feeds; troubleshoot upload errors

Request and manage category/gating approvals

Set up and maintain UPC/GTIN, brand registry, and catalog data accuracy

Update pricing, titles, and content as needed for seasonal or promotional changes



Customer Service & Case Management



Respond to customer inquiries and messages within platform SLAs

Open and manage Seller Support cases with Amazon and Walmart for account, listing, or order issues

Handle A-to-Z Guarantee claims, chargebacks, and buyer disputes

Process and track returns, replacements, and refunds

Respond professionally to negative feedback and product reviews, and request removal of policy-violating reviews when applicable



Inventory & Supply Chain Support



Monitor inventory levels across FBA/FBM and Walmart fulfillment; flag restock needs before stockouts

Create and track FBA shipment plans, and monitor shipment/receiving status

Monitor storage fees, aged inventory, and excess/long-term storage alerts

Coordinate with suppliers or the team on purchase order timing based on sales velocity



Promotions & Account Growth



Set up and manage Lightning Deals, Coupons, Prime Exclusive Discounts, and Walmart promotions/rollbacks

Support external traffic/deal-site coordination as directed

Monitor and manage the brand Storefront and Walmart brand shelf content



Reporting & Analytics



Prepare regular (daily/weekly/monthly) sales, PPC, and account health reports

Track key KPIs: sales, sessions, conversion rate, ACOS/TACOS, inventory health, and account health metrics

Flag trends, risks, or opportunities to the team proactively



Account Health & Compliance



Monitor account health dashboards daily (Amazon Account Health, Walmart Seller Scorecard) and address issues before they escalate

Respond to policy violation notices, IP complaints, and listing suppressions

Assist with reinstatement/appeal documentation if an account or listing is suspended

Stay current on Amazon and Walmart policy changes that affect the account

What We're Looking For

5+ years of hands-on experience managing Amazon Seller Central and/or Walmart Seller Center accounts end-to-end (please share account examples/portfolio)

Hands-on experience running Amazon PPC campaigns (Sponsored Products required; Sponsored Brands/Display a plus) and familiarity with Walmart Connect

Experience with day-to-day account operations: order management, customer service, case handling, and account health monitoring

Proficiency in Canva, Photoshop, or similar design tools for product image/infographic creation

Working knowledge of keyword research tools (Helium 10, Jungle Scout, Data Dive, or similar)

Experience creating and managing product listings, including variations and flat file uploads

Strong written English for customer communication and listing copywriting

Highly organized and able to independently manage multiple SKUs, cases, and tasks without heavy oversight

Reliable internet connection and own equipment

Comfortable with Google Sheets/Excel for reporting and task tracking



Nice to Have



Experience with Amazon Brand Registry, A+ Content, and Storefront design

Experience managing FBA shipment plans and inventory forecasting

Experience handling A-to-Z claims, suspensions, or reinstatement appeals

Experience with PPC automation/management tools like Helium 10 Adtomic or Perpetua

How to Apply



Please send:



Your updated resume/CV

A short portfolio or examples of product images/A+ Content you've created

Examples of PPC campaigns you've managed (screenshots or case study, with results if possible — sales figures may be redacted)

A brief summary of your experience with account maintenance, customer service, and case management

Your available hours and expected hourly rate



Subject line: "Amazon/Walmart VA – Full Account Management – [Your Name]"



We review applications on a rolling basis and will follow up with qualified candidates for a short paid trial task.

title: AI Video Editor — Short Form (Long Term, Room to Grow)
description:
We make short-form AI videos for health and wellness brands on
 and Instagram. You take a script we write, and turn it into a finished video using AI avatars.



What you'll do



Take a written script and a reference video

Create the video using AI tools (avatar, voice, b-roll)

Edit it, add captions, and submit by midnight PHT

Apply feedback so the next batch is better



You'll start with one avatar account (3 videos per day, Monday to Friday). Once you're consistent, you move to two accounts (6 per day). Weekends off.



Pay



$4 per video. At 3 videos a day that's about $260/month. At 6 a day it's about $520/month. Paid on time, every time, no exceptions.



This is a long-term position



We are not looking for someone for one month. My longest editor has been with me for four months and has never had a single complaint about pay, hours, or how they're treated. That's how I run things and it isn't changing.



There is real room to grow here. As we add brands and accounts, the people already on the team get more work and more money before anyone new gets hired. Roles above editing will open up too, and those go to people who are already here.



Who I'm looking for



Hungry. You want to get better, not just get paid.

Consistent. You hit deadlines every day, not most days.

Good instincts. You can look at a video and tell whether it's good, and say why.

Takes feedback well. I give detailed notes. Apply them and you'll move up fast.



Experience with AI video tools is a plus, but instinct and consistency matter more. I'll teach the rest.



How to apply — read this part carefully



Applications with no video attached will not be reviewed. There are two ways to show me your work. Pick either one.



Option A — recreate this video



Watch this video: 

Recreate it as closely as you can. Same structure, same pacing. Don't copy it exactly — make your version better if you see something you'd improve.

Send the link (Google Drive or Dropbox) and a short note on what you changed and why.



Option B — send work you've already made



If you've already made high quality AI videos in this exact style, skip the test and send those instead. Two or three of your best is enough.



You must include proof you actually made them. Any of these works: the project file, the raw export before captions, a screen recording of your timeline, or a link to the account they were posted on. Videos with no proof will not be counted.



With either option, include:



The word BLUEBIRD at the start of your message, so I know you read the whole post

Your 
 username — this is where we do all our work and communication

What AI tools you currently have access to, and which ones you don't



I'm hiring fast. I look at every submission personally, and if your work is genuinely good you'll hear from me quickly.

title: Bookkeeper & Executive Assistant — QuickBooks & Paychex Experience Preferred

I am looking for someone who understands the numbers, catches mistakes, stays ahead of deadlines, and keeps our financial records organized and accurate. You will work closely with me and help make sure everything is properly prepared for payroll, taxes, Paychex, and our CPA.



Bookkeeping & QuickBooks

* Managing and maintaining QuickBooks Online

* Accurately categorizing transactions

* Reconciling bank and credit card accounts

* Reviewing transactions for errors or discrepancies

* Keeping our books current, clean, and organized

* Accounts payable and expense tracking

title: Google Ads Manager – E-Commerce & Investment Campaigns
description:
ob Type: Part-Time initially, with potential for long-term/full-time work

Start: Immediately

Location: Remote – Philippines preferred

Experience: 3+ years of proven Google Ads experience

Industry: E-Commerce / Clothing / Investment



About the Role



We are looking for an experienced Google Ads Manager / Google Ads Specialist who can start immediately and take responsibility for managing and optimising our Google advertising campaigns.



We operate an online clothing business and want to significantly increase sales through Google Ads. We are looking for someone who understands how to advertise individual products and product categories, rather than simply running generic search campaigns.



You must be commercially minded and focused on generating actual sales and profitable ROAS, not simply generating clicks or impressions.



There will also be a second project involving the creation and management of a Google Ads campaign for an investment opportunity connected to our company.



Main Responsibilities – Clothing E-Commerce



You will be responsible for:



* Reviewing our existing website and Google Ads/Google Merchant Center setup.

* Identifying the products with the greatest sales potential.

* Creating highly targeted Google Shopping / Performance Max / Search campaigns.

* Setting up campaigns around specific products, brands, categories and high-intent searches.

* Reviewing product feeds and identifying any Merchant Center issues.

* Optimising product titles, descriptions, images and other information where required for advertising performance.

* Managing bids, budgets, keywords, audiences and search terms.

* Monitoring conversions and ensuring proper conversion tracking is installed.

* Analysing which products are actually producing profitable sales.

* Cutting wasted advertising spend.

* Scaling campaigns that are performing well.

* Continuously testing different products, audiences, keywords, ads and campaign structures.

* Providing regular reports showing spend, revenue, conversions, CPA and ROAS.



Sales Is the Priority



We are not looking for someone who simply manages an advertising account.



We want someone who understands e-commerce and can help us generate as many profitable sales as possible.



You should be able to look at our website and say:



“These products should be advertised first, this is how I would structure the campaigns, this is the budget I recommend, and this is how we can scale the winners.”



You should be comfortable making decisions based on actual performance data.



Second Project – Investment Opportunity



In addition to the clothing business, we want to create a separate Google Ads campaign for an investment opportunity associated with our company.



You will be expected to:



* Understand the investment proposition.

* Help identify the appropriate target audience.

* Research relevant keywords and audiences.

* Develop appropriate campaign structures.

* Create compelling but compliant ad copy.

* Build landing-page/conversion strategies.

* Set up appropriate tracking.

* Monitor leads and conversion rates.

* Optimise the campaign based on actual results.



Important: You must understand that financial/investment advertising can be subject to Google advertising policies and applicable laws. We expect the successful candidate to work within those requirements and flag any compliance issues before launching campaigns.



We Also Want You to Teach Us



This is very important.



We don’t just want someone to manage the account for us.



We want someone who can teach us what you are doing and why you are doing it.



You should be comfortable sharing your screen with us and explaining:



* How Google Ads works.

* How to create campaigns.

* How to select products.

* How to set budgets.

* How to read campaign data.

* How to identify profitable products.

* How to optimise campaigns.

* How to scale successful campaigns.

* How to identify wasted spend.

* How to use Google Merchant Center.

* How to understand ROAS, CPA, CTR, CPC and conversion rates.



We want to build a long-term working relationship where you become our Google Ads expert while also helping us become more knowledgeable ourselves.



Immediate Availability



We need someone who can start immediately.



You must be available for regular communication and be comfortable communicating through WhatsApp, Zoom/Google Meet or similar.



Initially, we would like to work closely together while the accounts are being reviewed and campaigns are built.



Requirements



You MUST have:



* At least 3 years of hands-on Google Ads experience.

* Strong experience with Google Shopping.

* Strong experience with Performance Max.

* Experience with e-commerce businesses.

* Experience advertising individual products.

* Experience with Google Merchant Center.

* Strong understanding of conversion tracking.

* Experience analysing ROAS and profitability.

* Excellent analytical skills.

* Excellent English communication skills.

* Ability to explain technical concepts clearly.

* Ability to work independently.

* Immediate availability.



Strongly Preferred



Experience with:



* Fashion/clothing e-commerce.

* Shopify or WooCommerce.

* Product feeds.

* Google Analytics 4.

* Google Tag Manager.

* Merchant Center.

* Performance Max.

* Search campaigns.

* Remarketing.

* Conversion tracking.

* Scaling e-commerce accounts.

* Lead-generation campaigns.

* Financial/investment advertising.



What We Expect From You



We want you to be proactive.



Don’t simply wait for us to tell you what to do.



If you see something wrong, tell us.



If you see an opportunity, tell us.



If you think we are wasting money, tell us.



If you think a particular product could generate significant sales, show us how you would advertise it.



We want someone who thinks like a business owner and understands that £1/$1/AED spent on advertising needs to produce a measurable commercial return.



First Week Objectives



During your first week, we would expect you to:



1. Audit our website.

2. Audit our Google Ads account.

3. Audit Google Merchant Center.

4. Review our product catalogue.

5. Identify tracking problems.

6. Identify immediate opportunities.

7. Identify products worth advertising.

8. Recommend campaign structures.

9. Set up the initial campaigns.

10. Begin optimisation and testing.

11. Explain everything to us as you go.



To Apply



Please DO NOT send a generic application.



In your application, please provide:



1. Your Google Ads experience:

How many years have you been managing Google Ads?



2. E-commerce experience:

Tell us about the e-commerce businesses you have worked with.



3. Clothing/Fashion experience:

Have you advertised clothing or fashion products before? If yes, explain.



4. Results:

Give us 2–3 examples of campaigns you have managed, including approximate advertising spend, sales generated and ROAS where possible.



5. Google Shopping / Performance Max:

Explain your experience with these campaign types.



6. Teaching:

Are you comfortable sharing your screen and teaching us how you manage the campaigns?



7. Availability:

How quickly can you start?



8. Working hours:

What hours are you normally available in Philippine time?



9. Your proposed approach:

If we gave you an online clothing store with hundreds of products tomorrow, what would you do during your first 7 days?



10. Your rates:

Please provide your hourly rate or monthly rate.



IMPORTANT APPLICATION TEST



At the beginning of your application, write:



“I CAN START IMMEDIATELY”



Applications that do not include this sentence may not be considered.



We are looking for someone who can start immediately, produce measurable results, communicate well, and become a long-term member of our team.



If you are confident that you can take an e-commerce Google Ads account, identify the products with the highest potential, drive sales and continuously improve ROAS, we would like to hear from you.

title: Go High Level & Zapier - Automation Specalist
description:
Automation Specialist



The role



You own every connection between our systems: SalesKick, GoHighLevel, Hyros, 
, Whop and the pages we build in Lovable.



Leads, bookings, reschedules, cancellations, call outcomes and sales all have to move between those tools. Right now nobody is watching whether they do.



Three things are needed from you: keep the automations we have running, fix them when they break, and build the ones we do not have yet. The full list is below.



The software stack we use

GoHighLevel. -Workflows, triggers, pipelines, tags, custom fields, calendars, snapshots,
s.

SalesKick - Where calls get booked. Bookings, reschedules, cancellations and no shows all start here.

Hyros - Attribution and tracking, in both directions with GHL.


 - Setter dialling lists, fed from GHL pipeline stages.

Lovable - Funnel and landing pages, and the webhooks that fire out of them.

Zapier - The glue between everything that has no native integration.

Stripe -  Purchases, upsells and refunds flowing into the CRM.

Whop - Payment Processor 



What you will actually do



- Run a daily check that every critical automation fired as expected, and log it. You tell us it broke, we never tell you.

- Watch webhook failures and Zapier error queues. Catch, fix, replay, then fix the cause so it does not happen twice.

- Confirm every SalesKick booking lands in GHL with the right owner, tags and pipeline stage.

- Keep the sales team calendars honest. Availability open where it should be open, blocked where it should be blocked, no double bookings, no ghost holds left behind by a cancelled call. A prospect must never see a slot that is not real, and a closer must never lose a slot that is.



Connect it

- Build webhook triggers from SalesKick for reschedules and cancellations, so a moved call updates the pipeline stage, the dialler list and the calendar without anyone touching it.

- Push call and sale data from GHL into Hyros, and pull attribution back onto the contact record so source travels with the lead.

- Wire Lovable pages and Stripe purchases into GHL with the correct tags, custom fields and pipeline stage.

- Sync pipeline stages to 
 lists so setters always call the right people in the right order, with no manual admin.



Build it

- Build new automations from a written spec. Speed to lead, no show recovery, rebooking, abandoned checkout, buyer nurture.

- Improve tracking until every lead carries its source from first click through to cash collected.

- Document every automation you build. What fires it, what it does, where it can fail, how to test it.



Report it

- One page every week. What broke, what you fixed, what you built, what is at risk next.

- Raise numbers that do not reconcile before anyone else spots them.



Who you are

Required, and you will be asked to prove each one:



- Two years or more building inside GoHighLevel. Workflows, triggers, custom fields, pipelines, calendars, snapshots.

- Genuinely comfortable with webhooks and APIs. You can read JSON, fire a test payload in Postman, and work out what an error log is telling you.

- Zapier past the template level. Filters, paths, formatter, webhooks, error handling.

- Experience with a call tracking or attribution platform. Hyros preferred, others considered.

- Written English clear enough to report a failure precisely and ask a precise question.

- Able to work 9am to 5pm UK time, Monday to Friday, which is a late shift in the Philippines. Your own machine, stable internet, and a backup for both power and connection.



Counts strongly in your favour:



- Hyros specifically.

- Lovable, or another AI build tool, plus enough JavaScript to read what it produced.

- Claude or similar used as a real working tool. Tell us what you built with it.

- Stripe webhooks, Supabase edge functions, or anything else where you have debugged a payload rather than just connected an app.

- Whop and 
.



This role is wrong for you if you wait to be told something is broken, if you need a ticket before you act, or if you would rather report a problem than fix it.



How we will judge the first 90 days

Day 30. Know what we have.

A single document listing every automation, webhook, Zap, form and tracking script across GoHighLevel, SalesKick, Hyros, 
, Whop, Lovable and Zapier. For each one: what fires it, what it does, where it sends data, whether it is live or dead, and when it last ran.



Daily health check running and logged from week two.



Day 60. Make it reliable, and make it repeatable for clients.

Sales team calendars accurate with no manual fixes. A GoHighLevel snapshot we can deploy into a new client sub-account, with the standard automations and tracking already in it. One client build delivered end to end from that snapshot, documented well enough that the next one is faster.



Day 90. Data Verification.

90% or better agreement between GoHighLevel, Hyros and the dashboard on leads, calls booked, calls shown and cash collected. Measured weekly by reconciling the same week across all three, with any gap over 10% explained in writing.

Client onboarding down to a repeatable day of work: snapshot deployed, webhooks connected, tracking verified.

No silent failure running longer than 24 hours before you catch it.



Hours and pay



Full time, Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm UK time.



$1,200 to $1,500 per month depending on experience, paid monthly. Reviewed at 90 days.



How to apply



Apply here:

 or DM instead will not be read.

title: ON-SITE CEBU CITY METRO, DAILY — Ops/Production Manager (Must Know Local Editors)
description:
ON-SITE IN CEBU CITY METRO, EVERY WORKING DAY — Operations / Production Manager, Small Video Editing Team (Cebu-based, must already know local editors)



We are a US-based media company that produces long-form YouTube content at scale. We are opening a small, dedicated editing office in Cebu City and we are looking for ONE strong manager to run it.



This is primarily a people-and-operations role, with hands-on editing as a backup skill — not a full-time editing job.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Recruit and build a team of 3-5 video editors here in Cebu City

- Manage the daily workflow: assign work, hold deadlines, keep quality consistent

- Train the team to our style and standards (we provide the system and the scripts)

- Judge editing quality and catch issues before they ship

- Step in and edit yourself when someone is out sick, or when something urgent needs to get done — not a daily requirement

- Manage the workspace, the equipment and attendance

- Report once a day to our team abroad — you are our person on the ground



THE 3-WEEK TARGET

What we mean by this: 3 weeks from your start date to having the office running with 3 editors actively working in it. That covers choosing the building, getting equipment set up, recruiting editors, and onboarding them — not 3 weeks until you personally walk through the door.



That said, quality matters more than hitting the number exactly. We would rather have week 4 with three good editors than week 3 with two good ones and one warm body rushed in to hit a deadline. The last two hires especially are judged on fit and quality, not just speed.



This is exactly why an existing network of editors in Cebu is a real advantage — recruiting from a cold start while also setting up an office in 3 weeks is genuinely difficult.



WHAT WE NEED

- ON-SITE IN CEBU CITY, EVERY WORKING DAY. This is not remote and not hybrid — if you cannot commit to being physically present every working day, please do not apply

- Experience as a team lead, lead editor, or someone who has supervised editors, managed workflow, or done QA/review on a team's output — tell us what that looked like

- Basic-to-solid hands-on video editing ability — enough to judge quality and step in when needed. You do NOT need to be a world-class editor or edit every day. Adobe Premiere Pro / After Effects preferred. Tell us what software you use and share a portfolio/reel

- Based in Cebu City, or ready to relocate before starting

- Excellent English, written and spoken

- Comfortable with project management tools (ClickUp, Trello, Asana or similar)

- NBI clearance and at least 2 references we can actually call



NICE TO HAVE

- Recruiting or hiring experience

- Experience with YouTube content

- Experience working inside a seat-lease / BPO facility



WHAT WE OFFER

- PHP 55,000 - 70,000 per month depending on experience

- Full-time, long-term, on-site in Cebu

- You build your own team and grow with the office as it expands



HOW TO APPLY

Put the word CEBU at the top of your reply so we know you read this ad. Then send:

1. A short note about a team or workflow you led, supervised, or did QA on, and how many people were involved

2. Your CV and a portfolio or reel showing your own long-form YouTube editing work

3. Your answer to this question: how would you recruit 4 good video editors in Cebu within 3 weeks?



Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete a small paid test/trial task before a final decision.



Applications without the word CEBU at the top will not be reviewed.

description:

:

This is a real

The brand. NuWave Botanicals, an online kratom retailer. Reference their voice here: 



The reader. Someone who signed up in the last week and hasn't bought yet. They've had two
s already: a welcome with the discount code, and one introducing the product range. They are shopping around. Most kratom sites look identical to them and many look sketchy.



The job of this
. Answer "why buy from NuWave instead of anywhere else." This is a trust
. The discount is the closer, not the argument.



The structure. Write copy for each block in this order:



Headline block. A hook plus a headline setting up NuWave as the one place to get everything. Then a CTA button label.

Selection block. Heading plus 2 to 3 sentences. Raw facts: carries 30+ brands including OPMS, MIT45, Hush, Whole Herbs, Remarkable Herbs, K Tropix, Zion Herbals, Kryptic, and Viva Zen, plus their own EXP and Experience house lines. One cart, one shipment.

Certification block. Heading plus 2 to 3 sentences. Raw facts: the American Kratom Association runs a GMP program that audits vendors against defined manufacturing and quality-control standards. NuWave is qualified under it. Most sites selling kratom are not.

Testing block. Heading plus 2 to 3 sentences. Raw facts: house lines are lab tested. For brands they resell, vendor certificates of analysis are on file and available on request.

Sourcing block. Heading plus 2 to 3 sentences. Raw facts: house lines come from Indonesian farming partners they work with directly, which is how they keep the product consistent year to year.

Two CTA button labels. One to shop, one to see lab results.

Offer block. 20% off, code WELCOME20. Short.

title: DaVinci Resolve Video Editor & Colorist
description:
PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING



This is NOT a basic short-form clipping position.



If the majority of your experience is:



Podcast clips

CapCut/template-based editing

Generic TikTok/Reels edits

Animated captions + random B-roll + zooms

Replicating the typical "Alex Hormozi" short-form editing style



this position is probably not for you.



We are specifically looking for an editor with strong professional post-production fundamentals, particularly colour grading, pacing and storytelling.



Colour grading is the #1 skill we are hiring for.



You must be genuinely comfortable grading professionally shot Log footage inside DaVinci Resolve. Applying a LUT and adjusting contrast/saturation is not what we consider colour grading.



Your portfolio must demonstrate this.



About Us



Aethon Studios is a marketing and media production agency based in Melbourne, Australia.



We operate as both a marketing agency and a professional production house, producing high-quality video content for businesses and organisations.



Our work ranges from polished cinematic/commercial productions to natural organic social content and direct-response Meta advertisements.



We care significantly about production quality, colour, storytelling, sound and attention to detail.



We're not looking to produce generic high-volume "content agency" edits.



The Role



We're looking for a full-time DaVinci Resolve Video Editor / Colorist to become part of our production team long term.



Most projects are short-form, generally 30–90 seconds, but the editing style varies significantly.



One project might be a highly polished 60-second commercial with cinematic visuals, detailed sound design and carefully constructed pacing.



The next might be a talking-head organic video that should feel completely natural and barely edited.



Another might be a paid Meta ad where retention, hook delivery and clarity matter more than cinematic presentation.



A strong editor needs to understand the difference.



We do not want somebody who applies the same editing formula to every video.



Your Responsibilities



You will:



Edit high-quality short-form social media content

Edit cinematic/commercial-style videos

Edit natural organic content without unnecessarily over-editing it

Edit direct-response Meta advertisements

Occasionally edit longer-form content

Assemble footage from multiple takes, cameras and angles into one cohesive narrative

Professionally colour grade footage in DaVinci Resolve

Match shots accurately across different cameras, angles and lighting conditions

Create dynamic captions natively in Resolve

Perform detailed sound design

Select appropriate B-roll where required

Use pacing, music/nasheed where applicable, silence and sound intentionally

Create clean, simple motion graphics in After Effects when required

Follow detailed production briefs accurately

Implement revision feedback precisely

Communicate proactively with our production team

Manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously

#1 REQUIREMENT — COLOUR GRADING



This is the most important part of the position.



You should understand concepts such as:



Log footage and proper normalisation

Colour-managed workflows

CSTs / colour space transformations

Exposure correction

White balance

Skin tones

Shot matching

Primary and secondary corrections

Node-based grading workflows

Mixed lighting correction

Highlight and shadow control

Noise reduction where appropriate

Creating a consistent look across an entire project



You should be capable of taking professionally shot Log footage and producing a polished, consistent commercial result.



If your colour-grading experience consists mainly of applying LUTs or presets, please do not apply.



What We're Looking For



In order of importance:



1. Excellent Colour Grading



This is non-negotiable.



2. Pacing, Storytelling & Narrative Sense



You should understand why a cut is being made, not simply where to make one.



3. Editing Versatility



You need to know when a video should feel cinematic and when the editing needs to disappear completely.



4. Advanced DaVinci Resolve Skills



Our post-production workflow is Resolve-based.



We are not looking for a Premiere-only editor.



5. Strong Sound Design



Sound should be treated as an important part of the edit, not an afterthought.



6. After Effects



Basic/intermediate AE skills are sufficient. We mainly require clean motion graphics and simple animations rather than complex VFX.



7. Communication



You need to be responsive, clear and proactive.



8. Reliability & Time Management



We produce a significant amount of content. Deadlines and consistency matter.



DO NOT APPLY IF



Please do not apply if:



You primarily edit using CapCut

You only know Premiere Pro and are not experienced in Resolve

Your portfolio consists mainly of podcast clips

Your main editing skill is captions, B-roll and transitions

You depend heavily on templates or presets

You cannot confidently grade Log footage

You use LUTs as a substitute for colour grading

You cannot explain your colour-grading workflow

You apply essentially the same editing style to every short-form video

You struggle to follow detailed instructions

You are looking to take on this position alongside several other full-time jobs



We would rather receive 20 highly relevant applications than 200 generic applications.



Compensation



AUD $1,500/month — Full-Time



Plus:



Performance-based bonuses

Long-term position

Opportunity for increased responsibility as the production team grows

Opportunity to work across professionally produced commercial and social projects



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with the agency rather than simply complete individual editing tasks.



HOW TO APPLY — READ CAREFULLY



Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be reviewed.



The very first word of your application must be:



Aethon



Then provide the following:



1. Your Best Colour-Grading Example



Send a direct link to the specific video you believe demonstrates your colour-grading ability best.



Tell us:



What camera the footage was shot on, if known

What Log/gamma profile or colour space you worked with, if known

Whether you personally performed the entire grade

Briefly explain what you did to the footage

2. Your Best Cinematic / Commercial Edit



Send one direct link.



Do not send us an entire folder and ask us to find something.



3. Your Best Natural Organic/Social Edit



We specifically want to see whether you know how to make a good video without over-editing it.



Send one direct link.



5. Answer These Questions



A. How many years have you used DaVinci Resolve professionally?



B. When matching several shots filmed under slightly different lighting conditions, briefly explain how you approach getting them consistent.



C. What is one colour-grading mistake you regularly notice in social media videos?



D. What is the difference, in your opinion, between editing an organic social video and editing a paid Meta advertisement?



Keep your answers concise.



Important



Do not send us a generic cover letter.



We will be evaluating your work before your resume.



Applicants who demonstrate strong colour grading, storytelling and attention to detail will be shortlisted.



Shortlisted candidates will then complete a video editing trial using footage supplied by us before a final hiring decision is made.



If you've read and understood everything above, you already know what the first word of your application needs to be.

If you have experience navigating SAM.gov, drafting winning RFPs/RFQs, managing vendor relationships, or driving public sector procurement operations, we want to hear from you!

???? WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR & SELECTION CRITERIA

We are building an elite team and hold high standards for execution, accountability, and accuracy.



THIS POSITION IS NOT FOR YOU IF:

title: Chargeback & Payment Dispute Specialist — E-Commerce — $6/hour
description:
We are a fast-growing international e-commerce company selling consumer products across multiple countries.



We are looking for a highly organized, reliable, and communicative Chargeback & Payment Dispute Specialist to take ownership of our payment disputes and chargebacks.



This role is especially suited for someone who is excellent at:



Following clear SOPs consistently every single day.

Staying organized even when handling many cases at once.

Keeping accurate records and documentation.

Communicating clearly with other team members.

Following up when something is missing.

Managing deadlines without needing reminders.

Paying attention to small details.

Taking responsibility for their work.



We already have clear systems and SOPs in place.



We are not looking for someone who ignores processes, skips steps, forgets to update cases, or waits until the last minute.



We want someone who can take a clear SOP, follow it accurately, communicate when something is unclear, and make sure every task is completed properly.



Your main responsibility will be to fight chargebacks, collect and submit strong evidence, communicate with our Customer Support team, track deadlines, and make sure no dispute is lost because of poor preparation, poor communication, or missed deadlines.



What Success Looks Like in This Role



A successful person in this role:



Checks every required platform every working day.

Follows our SOPs without skipping steps.

Keeps every chargeback properly documented.

Always knows which cases are urgent.

Communicates immediately when something is missing.

Follows up with Customer Support instead of waiting.

Updates statuses so the rest of the team knows what is happening.

Completes evidence before deadlines.

Double-checks their work before submitting.

Asks questions when something is unclear rather than guessing.

Takes ownership of problems until they are resolved.



Communication and organization are extremely important in this position.



If you notice a problem, we expect you to communicate it.



If you are waiting for information, we expect you to follow up.



If you cannot complete something, we expect you to explain why.



We never want issues to be ignored or left unresolved without communication.



1. Daily Chargeback Monitoring



You will monitor payment disputes across platforms such as:



Shopify Payments

PayPal

Airwallex

Mollie

Other payment providers we use



Your responsibilities include:



Check all payment platforms every working day.

Identify all new disputes.

Log every dispute immediately.

Record the dispute reason.

Record the dispute amount.

Record the evidence deadline.

Keep the status of every dispute updated.

Follow our chargeback SOP for every case.

Prioritize disputes based on deadlines.

Follow up on open disputes.

Track whether disputes are won or lost.

Communicate immediately if there is an issue you cannot solve.



No chargeback should ever be lost because someone forgot about it, skipped a step, failed to communicate, or missed a deadline.



2. Prepare & Submit Chargeback Evidence



You will prepare strong evidence for each dispute.



Depending on the dispute, evidence may include:



Order information

Customer information

Billing and shipping information

Tracking information

Proof of delivery

Shipping confirmation

Customer communication

Customer Support conversations

Refund history

Store policies

Refund policies

Shipping policies

Terms & Conditions

Screenshots

Product information

Other supporting evidence relevant to the case



You will be given clear SOPs explaining how different chargeback types should be handled.



We expect you to follow those SOPs carefully.



At the same time, you must understand the case you are working on.



Do not blindly copy and paste evidence.



Read the information.



Understand what the customer is claiming.



Make sure the evidence actually supports our case.



Double-check everything before submitting.



3. Communicate With the Customer Support Team



Communication with our Customer Support team is a very important part of this role.



You may need Customer Support to:



Contact a customer.

Send you missing information.

Explain what happened in a case.

Resolve a customer issue.

Ask a customer to collect their package.

Ask a customer to close a dispute after their issue has been resolved.

Provide screenshots or previous conversations.

Confirm whether a refund or reshipment was issued.



We expect you to communicate clearly and professionally.



Do not simply send a message and forget about it.



If you are waiting for information, follow up.



If something is urgent, make that clear.



If a deadline is approaching, communicate it.



If Customer Support has made a mistake that affects a chargeback, report it clearly so it can be corrected.



Good communication is one of the most important skills for this role.



4. Investigate Every Chargeback



Before submitting evidence, you should understand the full situation.



You should review:



The entire customer conversation.

Order history.

Tracking history.

Delivery status.

Previous refunds or reshipments.

Customer claims.

Internal notes.

Relevant company policies.



Do not make assumptions.



Do not skip information because you are in a hurry.



Follow the investigation process in our SOP and make sure you understand what happened before making a decision.



5. Deadline Management



You will often handle many disputes at the same time.



Being organized is therefore extremely important.



You will be responsible for:



Recording every deadline correctly.

Keeping an organized list of open cases.

Prioritizing urgent disputes.

Preparing evidence early.

Following up when information is missing.

Escalating problems before they become urgent.

Making sure nothing gets forgotten.



You should never need management to remind you that a chargeback deadline is approaching.



Managing your workload and deadlines is your responsibility.



6. Documentation & Organization



Every chargeback must be properly documented.



We expect you to keep clear records showing:



What happened.

What the customer claimed.

What evidence was collected.

What actions were taken.

Whether Customer Support was contacted.

What information is still missing.

When evidence was submitted.

The final dispute outcome.



Another team member should be able to open your documentation and immediately understand the status of the case.



If your work is not documented, it is considered incomplete.



7. Track Chargeback Results



You will track dispute outcomes and help us understand why we win or lose cases.



You should track things such as:



Chargeback reason.

Payment provider.

Amount.

Evidence submitted.

Outcome.

Win rate.

Reasons for losses when identifiable.



If you notice repeated problems, communicate them to management.



For example:



Customers frequently dispute delayed packages.

A specific shipping method creates many disputes.

Customer Support is handling a situation incorrectly.

Certain evidence is missing repeatedly.

We are repeatedly losing one specific type of dispute.



We want someone who notices patterns and communicates them clearly.



8. Improve Our Chargeback Process



Our SOPs are important, but they should also improve over time.



If you notice:



A repeated mistake.

An unclear SOP.

A missing step.

A better evidence structure.

A recurring communication problem.

A process that is causing unnecessary chargebacks.

We want someone who can follow systems extremely well while also helping us improve them.



Daily Responsibilities

Review upcoming deadlines.

Work through active cases.

Follow the correct SOP for every dispute.

Collect missing evidence.

Communicate with Customer Support when necessary.

Follow up on unanswered requests.

Submit completed evidence.

Double-check submissions.

Update dispute statuses.

Track wins and losses.

Report urgent issues.

Make sure there are no forgotten cases.

IMPORTANT



To confirm that you have carefully read this entire job description, please start your application with the words:



CHARGEBACK SPECIALIST



Applications that do not begin with these words will not be reviewed.



What We Are Looking For



The most important qualities for this position are:



Extremely Organized



You should be comfortable handling many active cases without losing track of deadlines, follow-ups, or missing information.



Excellent at Following SOPs



We have clear processes for how work should be completed.



We need someone who can follow instructions consistently every day.



Not just during the first week.



Not only when someone is checking.



Every single day.



You should not skip steps because you believe they are unnecessary.



If an SOP is unclear, communicate with us instead of guessing.



Strong Communication

We expect you to:



Respond clearly.

Ask questions when necessary.

Follow up.

Communicate problems early.

Explain what you need from another team member.

Keep people updated on important cases.



Ignoring a problem is never acceptable.



Reliable



If you are responsible for something, we expect it to get done.



We should not need to repeatedly remind you about your responsibilities.



Detail-Oriented



Small mistakes in chargebacks can cost the company money.



You must be comfortable checking details carefully and reviewing your work before submission.



Proactive



If something is missing, investigate it.



If someone has not responded, follow up.



If a deadline is approaching, act early.



If you notice a repeated problem, report it.



Do not wait until someone tells you what to do.



Experience



Previous experience handling chargebacks or payment disputes is strongly preferred.



Experience with any of the following is a major advantage:



Shopify

Shopify Payments

PayPal

Airwallex

Mollie

Gorgias

Gmail

Slack

Google Sheets

Excel

WhatsApp

Performance Expectations



Your performance will be evaluated based on:



Following SOPs correctly.

No missed chargeback deadlines.

Accuracy of evidence submissions.

Quality of evidence.

Organization.

Documentation quality.

Communication with Customer Support.

Following up properly.

Reliability.

Attention to detail.

Ability to manage many cases at once.

Chargeback win rate.

Ability to identify and communicate repeated problems.



We care heavily about consistency.



Doing a good job one day and becoming disorganized the next week is not enough.



We are looking for someone who can maintain the same high standard every working day.



Salary



$6 USD/hour



Full-time position: approximately 40 hours per week.



There is potential for increased responsibility, performance bonuses, and salary growth for someone who consistently performs at a high level.



How to Apply



Please include:

Describe your previous chargeback or payment dispute experience.

Which payment processors have you handled disputes with?

Have you used Shopify before?

Have you worked with PayPal disputes?

Approximately how many chargebacks have you handled?

Which software platforms have you used?

When can you start?



Please also record a 2–3 minute Loom video introducing yourself and explaining why you believe you would be a good fit for this position.



Interview Questions

Question 1



You have 30 active chargebacks across four different payment providers.



Five deadlines are within the next three days.



Explain exactly how you would organize your work.



Question 2

Final Note



We are looking for someone who is organized, reliable, communicative, detail-oriented, and excellent at following clear SOPs.



This is extremely important to us.



You will receive clear instructions and processes, but we need someone who can follow them consistently without needing to be reminded every day.

title: Virtual Prior Authorization & Insurance Verification Specialist
description:
**Remote Position | Outpatient Physical Therapy & Diagnostics**



Edge Physical Therapy & Diagnostics is seeking an experienced **Virtual Prior Authorization & Insurance Verification Specialist** to support our outpatient physical therapy and diagnostic practices.



This is a remote administrative position focused on ensuring patients are properly verified, authorized, and documented so care can proceed without preventable delays, denials, or lost revenue.



What You Will Be Responsible For



* Verifying insurance eligibility and benefits for new and existing patients

* Determining patient copays, coinsurance, deductibles, visit limits, and expected patient responsibility

* Determining whether prior authorization or referral is required

* Submitting and tracking prior authorization requests

* Monitoring authorization expiration dates and remaining authorized visits

* Requesting additional visits before current authorizations expire

* Communicating authorization limitations or issues to clinic staff

* Reviewing upcoming schedules to ensure patients are appropriately verified and authorized

* Monitoring progress notes and other documentation needed for authorization requests

* Faxing Plans of Care, Progress Notes, recertifications, and other required documentation

* Tracking physician signatures and following up on unsigned documentation

* Reviewing incoming faxes for authorizations and signed Plans of Care

* Uploading completed authorizations and signed documents into the correct patient chart

* Maintaining accurate authorization, insurance, and documentation information within the EHR

* Following assigned tasks through completion rather than simply submitting requests and waiting for someone else to follow up



Required Experience



* **Previous healthcare prior authorization experience is required**

* Experience verifying insurance eligibility and benefits

* Comfortable communicating directly with insurance companies

* Experience using insurance payer portals

* Strong attention to detail

* Ability to independently manage a large number of patients and deadlines

* Strong follow-up and organizational skills

* Comfortable working remotely and communicating with multiple clinic locations

* Ability to accurately document insurance and authorization information



Preferred Experience



* **TheraOffice experience is strongly preferred**

* Outpatient physical therapy experience

* Experience with Medicare and Medicare Advantage plans

* Experience with Humana, UnitedHealthcare, Cigna, Aetna, BCBS, WellCare, Medicaid, VA, and similar payers

* Experience with Availity and other insurance portals

* Experience obtaining authorizations for physical therapy

* Experience faxing and tracking Plans of Care and physician signatures

What Success Looks Like



The successful candidate will independently manage the administrative process from beginning to end:



**VERIFY → AUTHORIZE → MONITOR → OBTAIN DOCUMENTATION → SEND → FOLLOW UP → RECEIVE → UPLOAD → CLOSE**



Our goal is for patients to receive treatment without preventable interruptions caused by missing insurance verification, expired authorizations, incomplete documentation, or unsigned Plans of Care.



## Ideal Candidate



We are looking for someone who is proactive and does not wait for problems to occur.



You should be the type of person who notices that a patient has only two authorized visits remaining and begins working on the next authorization **before** the patient runs out.



You should be comfortable taking ownership of your assigned patients, following up repeatedly when necessary, and making sure tasks are completely resolved.



**This position is best suited for someone with prior authorization experience who can work independently with minimal day-to-day supervision.**





Please submit your resume and include a brief description of your experience with:



* Prior authorizations

* Insurance verification

* Physical therapy or outpatient rehabilitation

* TheraOffice, if applicable

* Insurance payer portals

title: Exciting Sales Closer + Ops Role for Busy Residential & Commercial Cleaning Company (US Based)
description:
Read every word. There's an instruction near the bottom that gets you hired. Miss it and you're out — that's test #1, and it starts now.



We're Greater Phoenix Cleaning. We clean homes and businesses across Phoenix, Arizona, and we are on a tear — building this into a multi-seven-figure company with locations opening across the United States.



Think of us like a championship sports team. Everyone here is a starter. Everyone is accountable. We train hard, we keep score, we celebrate the wins loudly, and we don't carry passengers. If you're used to hiding in the middle of a big org where nobody notices you coasting — you will hate it here, and we'll notice fast.



We're hiring ONE leader. A Closer. Someone who can run the day-to-day of a busy cleaning company, close deals on the phone, take an angry customer and turn them into a raving fan, keep a crew of cleaners moving, and stay calm and sharp when the day goes sideways — because some days, it will.



We hire leaders, not order-takers. If you need someone telling you what to do every hour, close this post — we'll both be happier. If you see a problem and just handle it, keep reading.



THE ONE THING THAT'S NON-NEGOTIABLE

We do not hire lazy. Not "a little lazy on Fridays." Not "lazy in the parts nobody sees." If you cut corners anywhere in your life, it shows up everywhere eventually — and it has no home on this team. We want the person who does it right when no one is watching, who finishes what they start, and who is a little annoyed by their own unfinished work. If that's not you, you already know, and this will save us both time.



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO



Close deals. Talk to people who want their space cleaned and turn them into paying customers. Negotiate, handle objections, win. Recurring customers and raving fans are the engine of this company. One-time cleans are not. Turning the customer into a fan and a long-term friend is the goal!



Own escalations. When a customer is upset, you step in, take the heat, fix it, and save the relationship. People feel handled when they deal with you.



Run the day. Keep jobs on track, connect customers and cleaners, put out the small fires before they become big ones.

Lead the crew. Not babysit — lead. Set the standard, hold the line, help people win.



Upgrade the machine. Spot what's slow or broken and build a better way. Solve a problem once so it never comes back.



WHO YOU ARE



Happy. Real energy. People feel better after talking to you. This matters more than you'd guess.

Hungry. You want to grow, earn, and build something real. Coasting bores you.

Humble. You take hard feedback like a pro and never think you're above the work.

Sharp. Fast learner. You connect dots other people walk right past.

A leader. You've led something — a team, a shift, a project — and you were good at it. People follow you without being told to.

A self-development junkie. Books, courses, podcasts — nobody has to push you. You sharpen your craft on your own time because you actually enjoy it.

Growth mindset. "I don't know how yet." Every setback is just data.



WHY THIS BEATS A CORPORATE JOB

No red tape. No politics. No pretending to look busy. We move fast, we have fun, we treat people like adults, and we keep score honestly. You'll work directly with the owner and have a real seat at the table as we scale nationwide. The people who join early and perform are the people who lead our future locations. We build leaders here — that's the entire point.



THE HONEST PART

This is demanding. Customers can be hard, days get chaotic, and you'll be trusted with a lot, fast. If you want easy and quiet, we are not it. If you want to be pushed, to grow, to earn, and to help build something that becomes a household name across America — welcome home.



Cleaning, home-services, dispatch, or field-team experience is a real plus. But we'll take a phenomenal leader and teach them cleaning over someone who knows cleaning but can't lead. Both? Even better.



HOW TO APPLY (this is the tryout — you're going to close us on camera)

We're a sales team. So don't type us an essay — we won't read a wall of text, and neither will your future customers. Get on camera and close us. If you can't close us on hiring you, you can't close the people who pay us. It's that simple.



Two things — that's the whole application:



-Put the word DESERT in the first line of your message so we know you read this. No DESERT, no reply. (Test #1 — passed or failed before we even hit play.)



-Record a 2–3 minute video of YOURSELF ON CAMERA — face visible. Not a voice-only clip. Not just your screen. You, talking to the lens like it's a customer who just said "let me think about it." Loom, YouTube unlisted, Google Drive — paste the link. In it, close us:

1. Who you are and why you're a leader, not an order-taker. Ten seconds. Don't ramble — tight is a skill.

2. One time you turned an angry customer or a bad situation completely around. Specifics. What you did, how it ended.

3. What you're doing right now to get better at your craft — the last book, course, or podcast you finished and the one thing you actually changed.

4. Then close. Ask us for the job. Handle the objection out loud: "Why you over everyone else applying?" Sell us. Don't be shy — that's the entire test.



No cover letter. No essay. If the video isn't there — or it's a black screen with a voice — we skip it, no exceptions. The people who won't get on camera are exactly the people we don't want on the phone.



We watch every video that comes in with DESERT. Show us the close.



Let's go build something big.



— The Greater Phoenix Cleaning Team

title: E-Commerce Creative Strategist
description:
About Us



We are a fast-growing seven-figure e-commerce team operating in the beauty niche. Our focus is building high-performing direct-response creative that drives profitable growth across paid social channels.



We are not looking for someone who simply copies competitors or scrolls Meta Ad Library for ideas. We are looking for a creative strategist who understands how to study winning brands, decode why their ads work, and turn those insights into original concepts that fit our brand, audience, and offer.



The right person understands hooks, angles, awareness levels, customer psychology, problem-aware and solution-aware messaging, and how to turn research into ads that sell.



Role Overview



As our E-Commerce Creative Strategist, you will be responsible for researching competitors, analyzing high-performing 8- and 9-figure e-commerce brands across multiple niches, developing original ad angles, and working with our creative team to produce winning ads.



You will study what is working in the market, identify patterns, and translate those patterns into fresh creative ideas for our beauty brand. This role requires a strong understanding of direct-response marketing, paid social advertising, consumer psychology, and e-commerce creative strategy.



You should be equally comfortable analyzing ads, writing hooks, building creative briefs, studying customer pain points, and developing new concepts that help us scale.



Responsibilities

Creative Research & Market Analysis



Research competitors in the beauty niche and identify winning ad formats, hooks, offers, angles, and messaging patterns.



Study 8- and 9-figure e-commerce brands across other niches such as skincare, supplements, fashion, wellness, home goods, personal care, and consumer products.



Analyze Meta Ad Library, TikTok Creative Center, landing pages, advertorials,
 funnels, product pages, UGC ads, founder-led ads, testimonial ads, and other creative assets.



Break down why certain ads are working instead of simply collecting examples.



Identify trends in customer psychology, creative formats, hooks, objections, mechanisms, and offers.



Build and maintain a swipe file of winning creative examples, organized by angle, awareness level, hook type, format, and niche.



Ad Concept Development



Develop original ad concepts based on research, customer insights, and brand positioning.



Write strong hooks, headlines, opening lines, scripts, and creative angles for paid social ads.



Create concepts for UGC ads, founder-style ads, problem-solution ads, testimonial ads, comparison ads, listicle-style ads, education ads, and direct-response product demos.



Understand and apply different customer awareness levels, including unaware, problem-aware, solution-aware, product-aware, and most-aware audiences.



Create messaging that speaks to customer pain points, desires, objections, buying triggers, and emotional motivations.



Translate research into clear creative briefs for video editors, designers, UGC creators, and media buyers.



Strategy & Testing



Work with the media buying and creative teams to develop structured testing plans.



Identify new angles to test based on performance data, market research, and customer feedback.



Analyze ad performance to understand which hooks, angles, formats, and messages are resonating.



Help refine creative based on metrics such as thumbstop rate, hold rate, CTR, CVR, CPA, ROAS, and other paid media performance indicators.



Develop creative iterations based on winning concepts without making the ads feel repetitive or copied.



Customer & Brand Understanding



Deeply understand our beauty customer, their problems, desires, insecurities, routines, objections, and buying behavior.



Study customer reviews, comments, competitor reviews, Reddit threads, TikTok comments, Amazon reviews, and other voice-of-customer sources.



Turn customer language into high-converting ad messaging.



Ensure creative stays aligned with the brand’s tone, positioning, and product benefits.



Avoid generic, overused, or “template-like” ads by developing concepts that feel native, fresh, and specific to our customer.



Requirements



2+ years of experience in e-commerce creative strategy, direct-response copywriting, performance marketing, or paid social advertising.



Strong understanding of Meta ads, TikTok ads, UGC content, and short-form direct-response creative.



Proven ability to research competitors and other successful e-commerce brands to identify useful patterns.



Strong copywriting skills, especially for hooks, ad scripts, headlines, and short-form direct-response messaging.



Understanding of customer awareness levels, including problem-aware, solution-aware, product-aware, and most-aware messaging.



Ability to analyze why ads work from a psychology, positioning, and creative structure perspective.



Experience creating creative briefs for designers, video editors, or UGC creators.



Strong taste in creative and ability to distinguish between generic ads and truly compelling concepts.



Comfortable working with performance data and using it to guide creative decisions.



Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple creative ideas and tests at once.



Nice to Have



Experience working with beauty, skincare, cosmetics, personal care, wellness, or women-focused e-commerce brands.



Experience with 7-, 8-, or 9-figure DTC brands.



Experience using tools like Meta Ad Library, TikTok Creative Center, Foreplay, Motion, MagicBrief, Minea, AdSpy, Notion, Google Sheets, or similar research/creative tools.



Understanding of landing pages, advertorials, funnels, CRO, and offer strategy.



Experience writing scripts for UGC creators or influencer-style ads.



What We Are Not Looking For



Someone who only copies competitor ads.



Someone who relies on generic hooks and recycled templates.



Someone who only collects ads but cannot explain why they work.



Someone who does not understand customer psychology.



Someone who needs to be told every angle to test.



Someone who cannot turn research into original creative ideas.



What Success Looks Like



You consistently bring fresh, well-researched ad concepts to the team.



Your creative briefs are clear, strategic, and easy for creators/editors to execute.



You understand what is working across the e-commerce landscape and can adapt those insights to our beauty brand.



Your hooks, angles, and scripts help improve ad performance.



You help us build a repeatable creative research and testing system.



You contribute original ideas instead of simply copying what competitors are doing.



Example Tasks



Research 10 winning beauty ads and break down the hook, angle, offer, awareness level, emotional trigger, and creative format.



Study 5 successful 8- or 9-figure e-commerce brands outside of beauty and identify creative patterns we can adapt.



Write 20 new hooks for a problem-aware audience.



Create 5 new UGC ad concepts based on customer reviews.



Turn a winning competitor angle into an original concept that fits our brand.



Analyze recent ad performance and suggest new creative iterations based on the data.



Who You Are



You are curious, strategic, and obsessed with understanding why people buy.



You enjoy studying winning brands, ads, funnels, and customer behavior.



You know that great creative is not random. It comes from research, psychology, pattern recognition, and smart execution.



You can look at an ad and explain the hook, the angle, the awareness level, the core promise, the objection being handled, and why it may be converting.



Most importantly, you know how to take inspiration from the market without copying it.

s and information

This is not just a basic page-building role. You should have a strong eye for design, user experience, e-commerce, and conversion rate optimization. You’ll be working across different brands and products, creating landing pages designed to look premium while also driving sales.

Strong hero sections

Product benefits

Social proof and reviews

Comparison sections

Trust elements

FAQs

Offers and bundles

Strong calls to action

An understanding of conversion rate optimization

Knowledge of how customers behave on e-commerce websites

Strong attention to spacing, typography, hierarchy, imagery, buttons, and overall page flow

Ability to follow brand guidelines while still using your own judgment

Bonus Skills

Figma experience

What Good Looks Like in This Role



You understand the difference between a page that looks good and a page that sells.
